ancient-structures-chinese.title: Ancient Structures: Chinese
ancient-structures-chinese.description: A Chinese structure pack mod for the Ancient Structures serie
ancient-structures-chinese.body:
## Ancient Structures: Chinese This mod is an extension from the [Ancient Structures](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ancient-cultural-structures) serie and add various structure inspired from China History into Minecraft. These structures adds customs mobs and various loots for the players to create a great experience. All the structures can be find in the Taiga and Oak forest biomes for now. ![Separator](https://i.imgur.com/yhha6Zo.png) ## About Ancient Structures [Ancient Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/ancient-structures) is a full-featured Minecraft mod that adds cultural, handcrafted structures from ancient civilizations directly into your world. It serves as a bridge within the Dawn of Time ecosystem, showcasing the architectural potential of Dawn of Time blocks and the animated armor models from Armor of the Ages through immersive world generation. The experience can be extended via the other structure mods from the Dawn of Time team. These packs are focused on a single culture to allow you to discover even more about architecture. Each pack is unique and reflects the team member style! * **[Knoxxturre](https://modrinth.com/user/Knoxxturre) :** Edo Japan * **[Jackiefr](https://modrinth.com/user/Jackiefr):** Chinese
![Separator](https://i.imgur.com/yhha6Zo.png) **The mod requires the following dependencies to work :** * [Dawn of Time](https://modrinth.com/mod/dawn-of-time) * [Armor of the Ages](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-of-the-ages) * [Garden Trails](https://modrinth.com/mod/garden-trails) * [Fusion](https://modrinth.com/mod/fusion-connected-textures) * [YetAnotherConfig (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl) ![Separator](https://i.imgur.com/yhha6Zo.png) ## Credits * **Jackie** – Creator of the building pack set * **TheGoldenWorld** – Made this project into a mod * [Retro Diffusion](https://www.retrodiffusion.ai/) has been used to generate the logo of this page

chinese-festivals.title: Chinese Festivals
chinese-festivals.description: Adding Easter Eggs to Chinese Festivals in the Game
chinese-festivals.body:
# Chinese Festivals
> Adds in-game Easter eggs for Chinese festivals

## Currently Supported Festivals

* Spring Festival
    * Changes item frame and glow item frame models to plates
    * Changes lantern and soul lantern models to lanterns
    * Updates 4 painting textures to Spring Festival couplets
    * Modifies creeper firework shapes
        * Dragon
        * Horse
    * Changes rabbit stew item model to dumplings
    * Changes beetroot soup item model to tangyuan (sweet rice balls)
* Lantern Festival
    * Changes lantern and soul lantern models to lanterns
    * Changes beetroot soup item model to tangyuan
* Qingming Festival
    * Changes baked potato model to qingtuan (green rice balls)
    * Changes item frame and glow item frame models to plates
    * Adds 3D models in plates for certain foods
* Dragon Boat Festival
    * Changes pumpkin pie model to zongzi (sticky rice dumplings)
    * Changes boat/raft model to dragon boat
* Mid-Autumn Festival
    * Updates moon texture
    * Changes cake model to mooncake
    * Changes cake and pumpkin pie item models to mooncakes
* Double Ninth Festival
    * Changes cookie item model to Chongyang cake
* Winter Solstice
    * Changes soul campfire model to clear broth hot pot
    * Changes campfire model to nine-grid hot pot
    * Changes soul campfire and campfire item models to hot pot
    * Changes rabbit stew item model to dumplings
* Laba Festival
    * Changes mushroom stew item model to Laba porridge
    * Changes rabbit stew item model to tangyuan

chinese-ancient-blade.title: 中华古刃 - Chinese Ancient Blade
chinese-ancient-blade.description:
这个模组为我的世界添加了中国华夏古时期的兵器，唐横刀，环首刀，雁翎刀，雁翅刀，苗刀，和轻功。
This mod adds ancient Chinese weapons from the Huaxia period to Minecraft, including the Tang Hengdao, the Ring-hilted Dao, the Yanlingdao, the Yanchidao, the Miaodao, and lightness skills.
chinese-ancient-blade.body:
**前置模组**：Player Animator，Geckolib.

**Required Mod**：Player Animator，Geckolib.

**演示视频**：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1kHPAzzEMC

**轻功视频**：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV19KFUzkErx

**Demo Video**：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1kHPAzzEMC

**Light Kung Fu Video**：https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV19KFUzkErx

**这个模组为我的世界添加了中国华夏古时期的兵器，** **唐横刀、环首刀**、**雁翎刀**、**雁翅刀**、**苗刀**。

**This mod adds ancient Chinese weapons from the Huaxia era to Minecraft, including the Tang Hengdao, Ring-shou Dao, Yanlingdao, Yanchidao, and Miaodao.**

![横刀](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/097c3f81120e3bd621dc99039f63bb3cba665e8e.png)

![刀](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e600c30bb2db465e45af57cd36747a069d47f49.png)

![仪刀](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1726da2fcc765ccaa2448cfc1ec28c26a12c12fa.png)

**——————————————————————————**

- **1.6.9（1.20.1 Forge）版本后**，更新且完善了轻功系统，并添加了轻体术，

- **1.6.0（1.20.1 Forge）版本后**，新增了**环首刀**、**仪刀**，且修正了**唐横刀**的形制问题，

- **1.3.9（1.21.1 Neoforge）版本**及以前中的横刀并不符合现实事实考究，

- 因而如今已经在**后续版本**中将其改名为“**佩刀**”，
并添加了两系列不同刀格的“**横刀**”，

- **1.7.5（1.20.1 Forge）版本**，新增**雁翎刀**、**雁翅刀**、**雁翅长刀**、**苗刀**，并给其和**空手**添加了**不同处决**，贴墙目视墙体按下潜行便可**走壁**。

- **After version 1.6.9 (1.20.1 Forge)**, the light movement system has been updated and refined, with the addition of light body techniques.

- **After version 1.6.0 (1.20.1 Forge)**, the **Ring-hilted Dao** and **Ceremonial Sword** were added, and the design of the **Tang Hengdao** was corrected.

- The Tang Hengdao in **version 1.3.9 (1.21.1 Neoforge)** and earlier did not align with historical accuracy,

- Consequently, in **subsequent versions**, it has been renamed to “**Peidao**” (Peidao),
and two distinct series of “**Tang Hengdao**” with different scabbards have been added.

- **Version 1.7.5 (1.20.1 Forge)**, added **Yanlingdao**, **Yanchidao**, **Yanchi Changdao**, and **Miaodao**, and added **different executions** for them and **bare hands**. While looking at a wall, press sneak to **wall-run**.

**——————————————————————————**


<details>
<summary>部分视图</summary>

![环首刀](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e600c30bb2db465e45af57cd36747a069d47f49.png)

![仪刀](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1726da2fcc765ccaa2448cfc1ec28c26a12c12fa.png)

</details>



个别武器手持在手依旧会有**特定效果**附加在身，

例如**环首刀**的攻击会给对方添加“**_割伤_**”效果，持续几秒；

**下界合金宝刀、金策卫横刀、寒铁脊横刀**：

持刀时讲持续消耗少量经验来给**伤害吸收**效果续航。

**青冰玉纹横刀**：

持刀时讲持续消耗少量经验来给力量效果续航。若误导了各位还请谅解，

收刀入鞘拿在副手可持续赋予玩家一级抗性提升，

模组可以搭配Better Combat游玩。

Certain weapons grant **specific effects** when wielded,
such as the **Ring-hilted Dao**, whose attacks inflict the “**_Bleeding_**” effect lasting several seconds;

**Nether Baodao, Golden Strategy Guard Hengdao, Cold Iron Spine Hengdao**:
While wielded, these weapons continuously consume a small amount of EXP to sustain the **Damage Absorption** effect.

**Blue Ice Jade Hengdao**:

While wielded, it continuously consumes a small amount of experience to sustain the Strength effect.

- Holding the sheathed sword in the off-hand continuously grants the player Resistance I.

This mod is compatible with Better Combat.

**——————————————————————————**

所有武器已内置合成表，可生存获取，

大部分兵器的合成走向是**单独制造刀和鞘**，有的则是**锻造升级合成**，

有的是需要合成刀条再合成刀，然后鞘，

_**建议安装可查看合成表的模组配合游玩。**_

All weapons feature built-in crafting recipes and can be obtained through survival gameplay.

Most weapons follow a crafting path of **separately crafting the blade and the sheath**, while some are made through **forging upgrades**.

Others require crafting the blade blank first, then the complete blade, followed by the sheath.

_**We recommend installing mods that display crafting recipes for optimal gameplay.**_

**——————————————————————————**

还包含一点**轻功系统**，按下**快捷键 G**（默认）激活内功后**即可操作**，

- 激活时按G可以**施展轻功**，以**消耗少量经验**为代价，

- 玩家处于**地面**和**空中**时**施展轻功**的效果是**不同**的，

- 在地面施展可以跃的更**远**，在空中施展则效果要**低**一点，类似于需要**借力**的道理。

- 激活内功同时可以**水上疾跑**，如果想施展轻功，建议先停下来再施展，

- 空中潜行按H便可释放三连踢，再聚气（Shift+H）后则可释放连续飞踢，例如佛山无影脚。

It also includes a **lightness skill system**. Press the **default hotkey G** to activate your internal energy, then **you can perform the skill**.

- Press G while activated to **execute the lightness skill**, at the cost of **consuming a small amount of experience**.

- The effects of **executing the lightness skill** differ depending on whether the player is on **ground** or in **air**:

- Ground activation allows for **longer leaps**, while aerial activation yields **slightly reduced** distance, akin to the principle of **leveraging momentum**.

- Activating internal energy also enables **water sprinting**. For optimal lightness skill execution, it is recommended to pause movement before initiating the skill.

- While airborne, press sneak + H to perform a three-kick combo. After charging (Shift + H), you can unleash a continuous flying kick, such as the "Foshan Shadowless Kick."

_**因为一些意外模组迁移到了1.20.1 Forge，暂时没办法回1.21.1 Neoforge，请谅解。**_

 > _**武器的外形参考于网络各处资料，有的是参考于某些影视作品，**_

 > **_也有部分是以其参考原型基础上修改的外观，如有纰漏，还请指出。_**

_**Due to unexpected mod migrations to Forge 1.20.1, we are temporarily unable to revert to Neoforge 1.21.1. I apologize for any inconvenience.**_

 > _**Weapon designs draw inspiration from various online sources, including references to certain films and TV shows.**_

 > **_Some designs are modified versions of their original prototypes. Should any inaccuracies be found, please point them out._**

huazhou-chinese-armor.title: HuaZhou : Chinese Armor
huazhou-chinese-armor.body:
For a long time, I haven't been able to find a Minecraft mod that accurately recreates **historical Chinese ancient armor**. Most mods either lean towards fantasy-style Chinese armor or are completely Western-style armor. **This mod will fill that gap**, presenting you with **authentic Chinese ancient armor**. 

In the update plan, I will start from the **Qin Dynasty** and create famous armor from each period all the way to the last Chinese dynasty: **the Qing Dynasty**. I might also make armor from the dynasties before Qin, namely **Xia, Shang, and Zhou**, but that will probably be much later. 

Anyway, **I hope you enjoy this mod and share it with your friends!**

![huazhou](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3f796fd87a47def00359f47413a8e9531e4865ce.jpeg)

chinese-ime.title: Chinese IME
chinese-ime.description: 一個支援拼音/粵語輸入法的 Minecraft 模組，用於輸入中文漢字。
chinese-ime.body: Chinese IME 是一個幫助你使用拼音輸入中文的 Minecraft 模組，並同時支援粵拼 (Jyutping) 輸入，適合粵語用家。 它支援簡體及繁體中文。 在Fabric上需安裝 Fabric API，同時可經 Sinytra Connector + Forgified Fabric API 在 Forge 及 NeoForge 上使用。 ## 功能 - 拼音和粵拼支援：輸入 拼音或粵拼，模組會根據你輸入的拼音從而建議相關的中文字。 - 音調支援：拼音/粵拼 後可輸入數字，模組會顯示對應聲調的建議。 - 支護簡體/繁體及粵語模式：可透過聊天介面右上角按鈕，在簡體、繁體及粵語模式間切換。 ## 如何使用 - 在聊天框中開始輸入拼音或粵拼，模組會顯示中文建議。如需選擇聲調，只需在末尾添加音調數字（如輸入 wo3 可獲得“我”）。 - 使用 ↑ / ↓ 鍵，鍵瀏覽字詞建議，按 Enter 選擇有關字詞。 - 同時可使用滑鼠選擇有關字詞。 - 按下聊天介面右上角按鈕則可切換簡體、繁體及粵語模式。 --- **Chinese IME** is a Minecraft mod that helps you input Chinese characters using Pinyin, with additional support for **Jyutping** input for Cantonese speakers. It supports both **Simplified** and **Traditional** Chinese characters. **Requires Fabric API. Also compatible with Forge and NeoForge, using [Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector), requires [Forgified Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/forgified-fabric-api).** ## Features - **Pinyin and Jyutping Support**: You can type in **Pinyin** or **Jyutping** for Cantonese, and the mod will suggest Chinese characters based on the letters you've entered. - **Tone Support**: You can use tones by typing a digit at the end, and the mod will display tone-specific suggestions. - **Simplified, Traditional, and Cantonese Support**: You can toggle between **Simplified**, **Traditional**, and **Cantonese** modes using a button on the chat screen. ## Usage - Start typing **Pinyin** or **Jyutping** in the chat, and the mod will show you suggestions of Chinese characters. If you want tone-specific results, just add the tone digit at the end (for example, `wo3` for "我"). - Use the **up** and **down** arrow keys to navigate suggestions, and **enter** to select a character. - You can also **scroll** through the list or **click** on the desired character to choose it. - Toggle between Simplified, Traditional, and Cantonese modes using the button on the top-right corner of the chat screen.

chinese-weapons.title: 中式甲兵 - Chinese Weapons
chinese-weapons.description: Chinese Weapons adds a variety of Chinese-style armors and weapons to the game, alongside an array of crafting materials and new ores.
chinese-weapons.body:
![English Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e45119f503a94c9d0f6cc4443f74a4c7de01db9c_0.webp)
Chinese Weapons adds a variety of Chinese-style armors and weapons to the game, alongside an array of crafting materials and new ores. The mod’s content is listed below.

# More Armors
Chinese Weapons introduces a variety of Chinese-style armor. This includes many variants derived from different iron Chinese armor sets, each with golden, diamond, and netherite tiers, range from general's fancy armor to infantry armor. All of these armors can be crafted in survival mode using the armor casting table in mod.
![All the armor of v.1.2.1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e8c73c534acf9e2d93dc12f5f686c516c631d00_0.webp)

# More Weapons
Chinese Weapons adds many new weapons: like the Dagger Axe, the Glaive, and the Sky Piercing Halberd,Guduo. All of these weapons feature unique abilities. For instance, the Dagger Axe can pull mobs toward you and deal damage upon right-clicking. The Sky Piercing Halberd inflicts knockback and applies a debuff to mobs when used while sneaking. The Glaive unleashes continuous area-of-effect damage when right-clicking while sneaking. These weapons can also be crafted in Survival mode!
![All the weapons of v.1.2.1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/81ee7e2b092cf845eb0981efc12bbd4e87b2251a_0.webp)

# More Crafting Materials
Chinese Weapons also adds a range of crafting materials to enhance the authenticity of forging weapons and armors. You may craft armors manually using armor plates at the armor forge table, or opt for a more convenient method: upgrading vanilla armors with the Forge Stone. Meanwhile, the mod introduces a new ore: Ancient Gem, which is used to craft special weapons.
![Lush cave scene: Armor crafting materials are displayed on deepslate brick walls.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9ce633d9da660aa716c9655205b124bfcd991fc.jpeg)

# Compatibility & Integration
Chinese Weapons supports [ JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) for viewing recipes of the mod's functional blocks, allowing you to quickly locate crafting recipes for armors and weapons. If you have [Patchouli](https://modrinth.com/mod/patchouli) installed, a guide book containing all mod content will be provided.
![Patchouli UI: Displaying a mod guide. This mod supports Patchouli.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16da5369cd20ef8b5978abd8524d0f956a7baa34_0.webp)

chinesechess.title: Chinese Chess
chinesechess.description: 五子棋，围棋，中国象棋 and so on
chinesechess.body:
For detailed Chinese description, please go to [象棋 - MC百科|最大的Minecraft中文MOD百科](https://www.mcmod.cn/class/6109.html).

# Introduction

Sometimes the strategy matters in Minecraft, which is similar to some Chinese chess games. 

This mod adds some Chinese chess games including Xiangqi, Weiqi, Wuziqi, Junqi, and Feixingqi.

It is recommended to play with your friends, but of course you can use them in a singleplayer game.

**The boards are generated in the world as structures and you have to make pieces**. You can check the recipes with JEI. 

## Xiangqi, Weiqi, and Wuziqi
![Xiangqi board and Weiqi board](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a202d0921e290a70f690a5c3f077ce2cb3b199d.webp)

You can find the introduction and rules here: 

[Xiangqi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xiangqi)

[Weiqi (Go)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(game))

[Wuziqi (Gomoku)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gomoku)

## Junqi
![Junqi board and piece](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/894a2d7aafb5134a390908de4c53b24d34bc82c2.webp)

You can find the introduction and rules here: 

[Luzhanqi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Luzhanqi)

## Feixingqi (Flight Chess)

![Feixingqi board](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65178f47535c81675e147cc0c2db085f08b75c00.jpeg)

The mod does not provide pieces for Feixingqi because you can use vanilla blocks as pieces. For example, redstone blocks, gold blocks, diamond blocks, and emerald blocks.

The mod provides a dice block. You can roll a dice in two ways:

1. Right click to place the block.
2. Press Q to throw it as item entity. It converts to a block after it stops moving.

You can find the introduction and rules here: 

[Aeroplane_chess](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aeroplane_chess)

This Origin is Coded in 1.10.0 of origin, so for other versions or forge version, there may having bugs that not expected.

# Chinese Zodiac Class

The Twelve Chinese Zodiac has arrive Minecraft as Origins Classes.

-|-|-|-


<details>
<summary>子鼠 Rat</summary>

###  Blessed by the spirit of the Rat, the first of the Chinese Zodiac. Known for wit, adaptability, and resourcefulness, you thrive in cities and find opportunities where others see obstacles. However, you are smaller and weaker than most, needing to rely on your cunning to survive.


- 🏃‍♀️ **Urban Adaptation**
  - You are naturally attuned to urban environments, moving with increased speed and agility.
- 🏃‍♀️ **Nimble Escape**
  - You can squeeze through small spaces and gain a burst of speed to evade danger.
- 🍀 **Resourceful Scavenger**
  - You have a knack for finding useful items in discarded resources. You have a luck effect when near chests, barrels, and loot crates.
- 🤕 **Small Build**
  - Being a small build makes you more weak and hungry. You take no fall damage.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Rat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/b81ddda8191142ce6f5e61f3b1e5c21e8e9b34dd.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>丑牛 Ox</summary>

###  Granted the strength and resilience of the zodiac's Ox, you possess unwavering determination and a connection to the earth. Your diligence allows you to overcome obstacles with steadfast resolve.


- 💪 **Earthbound Strength**
  - Your connection to the earth grants you immense physical strength and resistance to knockback while on the ground.
- 💪 **Steady Stamina**
  - You possess incredible stamina and are resistant to exhaustion. You can work tirelessly without tiring easily.
- 🐢 **Plodding Pace**
  - Your steady, determined nature makes you less agile in the water. Swimming speed is significantly reduced.
- 🧱 **Hard Labor**
  - Breaking blocks requires more effort as your strength is more suited to enduring rather than immediate destruction.
- 🛡️ **Stubborn Resolve**
  - Gain temporary resistance when taking damage. Can only trigger this again after 30 seconds.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Ox](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/2324e4767a7b1aa366c0ccb05ac320ed5186c993.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>寅虎 Tiger</summary>

###  Blessed by the Jade Emperor with the spirit of the tiger, you possess immense strength, courage, and a touch of arrogance. But beware, the world sees you as a threat, and your bold nature can lead to recklessness. 


- 💪 **Tiger's Strength**
  - You possess incredible physical strength, dealing significantly more melee damage.
- 💥 **Fearless Roar**
  - Unleash a deafening roar that weakens nearby enemies, inflicting Slowness for a short duration.
- 🕵️‍♂️ **Prowling Hunter**
  - Gain increased movement speed and night vision while sneaking, allowing you to stalk your prey effectively.
- 👁️ **Cat's Eyes**
  - Grants the user night vision.
- 😬 **Arrogance**
  - You take increased damage from ranged attacks. Your pride makes you underestimate your foes.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Tiger](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/1ef9dcaf9b485cf3a57761cf233862208095dd53.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>卯兔 Rabbit</summary>

###  Blessed by Chang'e, the moon goddess, you embody the qualities of the Rabbit in the Chinese Zodiac: gentle, kind, and skilled in herbalism and lunar magic. You are at peace in the moonlight and possess a natural affinity for plants and healing. 


- 🚀 **Lunar Grace**
  - Gain increased speed and jump boost during the night.
- 🌙 **Moonlit Healing**
  - Regenerate health faster under the moonlight.
- 🛡️ **Chang'e's Blessing**
  - You have a natural resistance to fall damage.
- 😱 **Night Blindness**
  - You are easily spooked in the dark. You gain Night Vision.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Rabbit](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/86aabcb2e82cbd68d8cccc5024165d40c1e695c0.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>辰龍 Dragon</summary>

###  Blessed by the Jade Emperor with the might and majesty of the dragon, you are a powerful and auspicious being. However, your pride and ambition can lead to challenges.


- 🔥 **Dragon's Breath**
  - Unleash the dragon fire!
- 💨 **Celestial Flight**
  - Fly like the wind!
- 🛡️ **Dragon Scales**
  - Your skin is incredibly tough, providing natural armor.
- 🍀 **Auspicious Presence**
  - Your very presence brings good fortune, increasing the chance of rare drops.
- 🚀 **Weakened Grounded**
  - Dragons are creatures of the sky, being confined to the ground is not your preference. You move slightly slower.
- 🔥 **Prideful Sleep**
  - Sleeping in a bed is difficult for a dragon. The bed feels awkward and is quickly destroyed.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Dragon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/ff11b1ded1056affabdffbd36d749ef32dcc9a84.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>巳蛇 Snake</summary>

###  Born under the sign of the Snake, you possess cunning, wisdom, and a deep connection to the earth. You are resourceful and possess a natural affinity for shadows and hidden paths. However, you may be perceived as secretive and prone to manipulation.


- 👁️ **Serpent's Sight**
  - Enhanced vision, allowing you to see clearly in caves and at night.
- 🏃‍♀️ **Shed Skin**
  - Once every Minecraft day, you can shed your skin, granting a temporary boost to speed and agility.
- 💀 **Venomous Bite**
  - Your attacks have a chance to inflict poison on your enemies.
- ⬇️ **Earthbound**
  - You are more comfortable on the ground and are less effective in the air.
- 🥶 **Cold Blooded**
  - You are vulnerable to extreme cold. The Wither effect drains you if you are in snow biome.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Snake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/f9bcaeb845707290f4e830adb08f2cbf2250cb07.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>午馬 Horse</summary>

###  Blessed by the spirit of the Horse, you are swift, energetic, and possess a natural talent for leadership. However, your independent spirit may sometimes lead to restlessness and a reluctance to follow the crowd.


- 🚀 **Swift Steed**
  - Your base movement speed is significantly increased.
- 💨 **Untamed Spirit**
  - Gain a burst of speed when sprinting, but experience exhaustion shortly after.
- 🚀 **Leaping Gait**
  - You can jump higher than other players.
- 🐌 **Restless Heart**
  - You need less sleep than other players, reducing Phantom spawn chances. However, staying in one place for too long causes Slowness.
- 🤕 **Fragile Hooves**
  - You take slightly increased fall damage.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Horse](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/0d90cabbdfd0546c63948208e46924f9f47d194a.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>未羊 Sheep</summary>

###  Blessed by the celestial Sheep, you embody compassion, artistry, and a touch of mischievousness. Your connection to the earth grants you unusual resilience, but you may find confrontation difficult.


- 🌿 **Herbal Remedy**
  - You have an innate understanding of herbs and plants. Consuming any plant grants enhanced healing.
- 🛡️ **Earthen Fortitude**
  - Your connection to the earth gives you resistance to all damage.
- 🌱 **Pastoral Affinity**
  - Grants increased movement speed on grassy and floral terrain.
- 📉 **Weak Punches**
  - Deals less damage by 25% to entities
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Sheep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/a99a34a7f55f24cfe14fe112ee3ed9ff7f62ba4c.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>申猴 Monkey</summary>

###  Blessed by the spirit of the Monkey, you possess incredible agility and a mischievous nature. You excel in climbing and swift movement, but your playful tendencies can sometimes lead to trouble.


- 🧗‍♀️ **Nimble Climber**
  - You are incredibly adept at climbing, scaling even the smoothest surfaces with ease.
- 🤸‍♀️ **Acrobatic Leap**
  - Your innate agility allows you to perform powerful jumps and aerial maneuvers.
- 🚀 **Swift Footwork**
  - You are naturally faster than most, allowing you to move quickly across the land.
- 🤕 **Fragile Limbs**
  - Your agility comes at a cost. You are more susceptible to fall damage.
- 😩 **Easily Distracted**
  - You find it difficult to focus for extended periods. Experience gain is reduced.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Monkey](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/8c948b71e5bb69dccc41eca615819dbad5a8a9ac.png) 
</details>

<details>
<summary>酉雞 Chicken</summary>

###  Blessed by the Jade Emperor with the spirit of the Rooster, you possess unwavering confidence, meticulous precision, and a touch of flamboyant charm. You are a natural leader, blessed with sharp observation skills and a strong sense of justice.


- 🌅 **Dawn's Herald**
  - Like the rooster crowing at dawn, you possess enhanced awareness and reflexes, especially at the start of each day.
- 🧐 **Meticulous Precision**
  - Your inherent attention to detail makes you a master craftsman and a keen observer.
- ⚔️ **Combative Flair**
  - You possess a unique fighting style, incorporating swift movements and a surprising burst of strength when using swords.
- 🚀 **Grounding Ascent**
  - Your grounding and ability to rise to any occasion empowers you to jump higher.
- 😠 **Dust Bath Aversion**
  - As the rooster is always vigilant, the sound of dust angers you.
- 🌑 **Nighttime Vulnerability**
  - The darkness diminishes your natural confidence and alertness.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Rooster](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/1154735314b7a7a17fdef2d5e9cc89e76ff7111f.png)
</details>

<details>
<summary>戌狗 Dog</summary>

###  Born under the sign of the Dog in the Chinese Zodiac, you embody loyalty, honesty, and a strong sense of justice. You are a steadfast friend and protector, always vigilant and ready to defend those you care for.


- 🤝 **Unwavering Loyalty**
  - You are fiercely loyal to your allies, and gain bonuses when near them.
- 🦉 **Night Watch**
  - Your senses are heightened at night, allowing you to see and stronger at night.
- 👁️ **Honest Heart**
  - You are immune to the effects of illusions.
- ✨ **Zodiac Power**
  - You have particles around.
![Dog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/S7Wm0608/images/aff9fbddb3579e12fcb464aa23e0af40e515a6f4.png)

<details>

###  Born under the sign of the Pig, you are known for your kindness, generosity, and good fortune. You have a strong sense of justice and a natural talent for attracting wealth and abundance.


- 💰 **Golden Touch**
  - You have a natural affinity for wealth and good fortune.
- ✨ **Generous Spirit**
  - Your innate generosity extends to those around you, granting blessings to nearby allies.
- 🛡️ **Fortitude**
  - You also have the 'Resistance' effect permanently.
- 🚀 **Unwavering Resolve**
  - Your determination is unmatched, allowing you to push through fatigue. You gain the 'Haste' effect permanently. You also recover from the 'Mining Fatigue' effect three times faster.

geng.title: Geng: Chinese Meme Craft
geng.body:
This is a Minecraft mod called Geng.

This mod use [AFL-3](https://opensource.org/license/afl-3-0-php) License.

## Mod Description
- This mod added many items, effects, foods about Chinese memes:
  - The cake of capital
  - Hundred Tons King
  - Huaqiang's Melon
  - North Korea's Kindness
  - Lie Detector
  - Pinxixi
  - Russian Proportion
  - Shanghai Mixuebingcheng
  - Wangzai Xiaoqiao Event
  - and so on
- This mod supports the following languages:
  - English
  - Simplified and Traditional Chinese
  - Japanese
- Mod dependencies:
  - Minecraft 1.21.1
  - NeoForge 21.1.176+
  - Pehkui Mod


## Installation Step
1. Jump [here](https://modrinth.com/mod/geng/versions).
2. Choose a version, and then download it.
3. Ensure that pre installed resources and appropriate versions of NeoForge have been installed.
4. Put the downloaded mod into the mods folder.
5. Start the game and enjoy the world of Chinese memes!


## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What should I do if the mod causes the game to crash?

A: Please check if there are any conflicts with other mods and submit Issues with crash logs attached. Submit the bugs on the [Issues](https://github.com/aiLinMc/Geng/issues) page!

Q: How to suggest new memes?

A: Submit your ideas on the [Issues](https://github.com/aiLinMc/Geng/issues) page!

Q: Do you support other versions of Minecraft?

A: Currently only supports 1.21.1. Unfortunately, I may only stay at that version update.


## Sponsored Link
If you are Chinese, please jump to [this page](https://afdian.com/a/aiLinMc) to sponsor.

Sponsorship links for countries other than China have not yet been opened.

**Your sponsorship is my biggest motivation for updating!**

japanese-temple.title: Japanese Temple - Structure ✅
japanese-temple.description: A Japanese Temple is a tranquil in plains complex in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by traditional Shinto and Buddhist architecture, featuring sweeping curved eaves, tiered pagodas and torii gates, stone lanterns, and wooden joinery.
japanese-temple.body:
![1](https://i.imgur.com/I4gBN32.png)

![2](https://i.imgur.com/iEmURfm.png)

Japanese Temple Mod for Minecraft transforms your plains into a tranquil Japanese temple complex in a vanilla-friendly style. Inspired by traditional Shinto and Buddhist architecture, the mod adds tiered pagodas, towering torii gates, sweeping curved eaves, koi ponds, stone lanterns and manicured zen gardens—creating authentic, photogenic points of interest that blend seamlessly with the plains biome. Perfect for builders, explorers and creative servers, this Japanese temple mod for Minecraft brings atmosphere and cultural detail without breaking the vanilla aesthetic.

![3](https://i.imgur.com/8GyyNIW.png)

The mod features natural generation in the plains biome, handcrafted wooden joinery and decorative blocks designed to match vanilla textures, hidden meditation chambers and secret passages for rewarding exploration, and multiple structure sizes to suit solo builds or grand server landmarks. With carefully placed ponds, stone paths and lanterns, every temple feels intentional and immersive, offering new storytelling and screenshot opportunities for map makers and roleplay communities.

![4](https://i.imgur.com/PJRr6WK.png)

Easy to install and optimized for performance, Japanese Temple Mod is compatible with common Minecraft setups and suitable for both single-player and multiplayer servers. Whether you’re creating an adventure map, a serene photo spot, or a cultural landmark, download the mod to add a corner of calm and beauty to your plains—bring traditional Japanese architecture into your Minecraft world today.

_Build credits to zzFreeKill_

japanese-castle.title: Japanese Castle - Structure ✅
japanese-castle.description: Japanese Castle is a fortified stronghold in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by traditional Japanese architecture, featuring tiered towers, curved rooftops, and defensive walls.
japanese-castle.body:
![1](https://i.imgur.com/XfVEyjJ.png)

Step into history and explore the might of the samurai with the Japanese Castle Mod! This mod adds majestic tiered castles, curved rooftops, and fortified walls to Minecraft, generating in plains and mountain biomes as towering strongholds overlooking the land. Each fortress reflects the elegance and power of traditional Japanese architecture, bringing culture, defense, and hidden chambers into your world.

![2](https://i.imgur.com/tlJ8KR6.png)

Perfect for players who enjoy exploration, world-building, and uncovering landmarks with cultural and historical depth, the Japanese Castles serve as distinctive points of interest to enhance your Minecraft adventures. Climb the towering keeps, walk along the fortified walls, and immerse yourself in the elegance of traditional architecture that echoes the legacy of a bygone era.

![3](https://i.imgur.com/WXaqMhe.png)

Whether you're a solo adventurer or part of a multiplayer server, these castles add atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling potential to your world. A Japanese Castle is more than a fortress—it’s an invitation to experience the grandeur of feudal architecture while transforming the landscape of your Minecraft realms.

![4](https://i.imgur.com/Yudw70v.png)

japanese-offering-shrines.title: Japanese Offering Shrines

japanese-offering-shrines.body:
![Cherryo Blossom Shrine](https://i.imgur.com/G4XYxTQ.jpeg)

Step into the past and explore the enigmatic world of **forgotten offering shrines** with the **Japanese Offering Shrines Mod!** This mod introduces realistically generated shrines ruins into Minecraft, appearing in **cherry groves and forests.** Each shrine captures the mysterious aura of the real-world monument, making your world feel alive with history and ancient secrets.

tatamicraft-japanese-building-blocks.title: TatamiCraft: Japanese Building Blocks
tatamicraft-japanese-building-blocks.description: Adds tatami, shoji, fusuma and other traditional Japanese building blocks for creating Japanese-style architecture.
tatamicraft-japanese-building-blocks.body:
**TatamiCraft** adds traditional Japanese-style building blocks, Tatami/畳.

This mod introduces blocks such as **tatami mats and other Japanese architectural elements**, allowing players to create authentic Japanese interiors and buildings.

![Tatami blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd47656a1e27f0b2e6e6d2832631e99e13634589.jpeg)

### Obtaining

Use commands like these.

```
/give @p tatamicraft:tatami
/give @p tatamicraft:tatami_half
```


### Crafting

Tatami can be crafted using wheat and string.

```
W W
S S
```

* W = Wheat
* S = String

You can also craft Half Tatami, or split a full Tatami into two halves.

Tatami blocks can be dyed into 10 or more different colors using standard Minecraft dyes.

### Features

* **Tatami and Japanese building blocks**
* **Thin block design** similar to carpets, ideal for floors and interior decoration
* Designed for **Japanese-style houses, temples, and traditional rooms**
* Lightweight and simple building-focused mod

### Compatibility

* **Minecraft:** 
  * 1.20.1
  * 1.21.11
* **Loader:**
  * Fabric
  * NeoForge

---

### v1.1.0 Update: Fusuma Blocks

Version 1.1.0 adds **Fusuma blocks**, traditional Japanese sliding doors used in tatami rooms and Japanese-style interiors.

Fusuma blocks are designed to match tatami floors and other Japanese architectural blocks, making it easier to create authentic washitsu rooms, temples, inns, and traditional houses.

These blocks can be used as decorative partitions or interior doors, helping players build more detailed Japanese-style spaces.

japanese-altar.title: Japanese Altar
japanese-altar.description: Adds a Japanese-styled altar that grants various effects when given an offering.
japanese-altar.body:
## About
Japanese Altar adds a new block, the altar, to the game. The altar can be crafted and when used will grant the player a blessing. It can also be placed for decoration.

![The altar block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0155d10a34f5aebe74359c64b7aa3bec5d229ae5.png)
#### Mod Loader
Fabric Loader

## How to Craft an Altar
An altar requires polished andesite, wooden fences, and wooden slabs.

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ed1f264742b0bddadc8a1bce3ff39b38cd8bfdac.png)

## How to Use an Altar
The altar will bestow a status effect when the player gives an offering at the altar.

To make an offering: 
1. Have at least 5 XP levels
2. Have a valid offering in your main hand
3. Right-click the altar with the offering
### Blessings
When a player is blessed with a status effect, it will last for half of a Minecraft day (10 minutes). You can only have one blessing at a time. To get another blessing, you must wait out the effect or drink milk to clear the effects.
### Basic Offering VS Special Offering
- A basic offering is made when you offer bread. This will give you a random effect.
- A special offering is made when you offer a specific item. This will give you a more specific effect.
### Effects List & Offerings
An offering of bread will give a random effect.
#### Specific Offerings & Effects
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
- Glistering Melon
> - Regeneration
- Golden Carrot
> - Saturation
- Blaze Powder
> - Strength
- Golden Apple
> - Resistance
> - Absorption V
- Sugar
> - Speed
> - Haste

</details>

![An altar beneath a cherry tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/fgdyrENw/images/5770cf07214390df06ac687a0f6528293fc1cc81.png)

teleportation-shrines.title: Teleportation Shrines
teleportation-shrines.description: Linkable Shrines to fulfill all your teleportation needs!
teleportation-shrines.body:
Are you tired of building nether portal hubs to connect your friends' and your homes, but in need for a **fast** and **efficient** way? Seems like **Teleportation Shrines** are exactly what you were looking for! This datapack adds **mystical shrines** which can be **connected** to travel **between different places at ease** :) ## Usage Teleportation Shrines can be crafted like this: ![First row: 3 Polished Blackstone; Second row: Ender Pearl, Eye of Ender, Ender Pearl; Third Row: Polished Blackstone, Soul Sand, Polished Blackstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/623d26280a13d3b8b2f016f2fc61a5a83bba8cd3.png) After you place them down you will be able to open their GUI and will be able to see and configure **5 carefully crafted refined types of the vanilla minecraft ores**! ![Teleportation Shrine GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d54b89616124d7cbf9a3130ecb306136ec19198.png)

You can click them to select the next one. (Toggling happens in this order: Emerald, Gold, Amethyst, Redstone, Lapis, repeat 🔂) If **two shrines show the same collection of ores in the same order** they will be **linked** - which means you can now teleport yourself from one to the other shrine! To do so simply stand on top of a linked shrine and sneak for a few seconds. If **blue particles** start appearing around your character, that means you did **everything correctly** and will be teleported shortly :)
...however if **red flames** start appearing around you you _might_ have **done something wrong** and I'd reccomend stepping off the shrine before it takes you to the wrong place... or causes you to _splinch_ The shrine you are **teleporting to** will also show **particles** to inform people around that someone new is arriving - keep that in mind while invading other people's places... your **invisibilty potion won't help you when dabbling in ancient magic** Speaking of ancient magic... our current understanding of it is limited, **preventing you from using this way of traveling in dimensions other than the overworld**- this may be changed as our knowledge evolves ⚠️ **Please note that even with the mod version of this datapack installed, you can not use /give to obtain shrines. Use `/loot give @s loot tp_shrines:block/teleportation_shrine` instead** ## Known Bugs These Bugs are known and should be kept in mind and will be fixed in a future update. To report new bugs please visit this datapack's GitHub page - **trying to put any item into one of the 5 "ore slots" in a Teleportation Shrine will permanently delete it. don't do this.** - none :) ## Interested in making your own datapacks? :) I am part of a small team of people owning **Datapack Hub**, the perfect discord server for helping you do just that! Wether you are just getting started or have advanced questions, with 1700+ members and our team of verified helpers we got you covered!

void-shrine.body:
Void Shrine is a completely unique evolution of Base Shrine from Jujutsu Kaisen Cursed Fate.

you can get it by crafting a Totem of Malice and Dejection (crafting recipe is automatically given) and pop it, but you need to have base shrine in order for that to work.

This technique is actually stronger then Calamitous Shrine in strength and attack potency, its got a large array of attacks that all have custom effects and animations and unique features (its also all purple). here's its move set:

NOTE: there is a gamerule to turn off destruction.

# Ability 1: Void Swordplay

buttercups-shrines.title: Buttercup's Shrines
buttercups-shrines.description: Prove your might in a test of strength... a new challenge awaits in your world!
buttercups-shrines.body:
Inspired by the likes of _The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild_, this datapack introduces one new structure to your world: the Shrine! Don't be fooled by its simple exterior, however; descend the ladder and you'll be met with one of 10 unique chambers to test your strength against waves of different mobs! If you're lucky- or perhaps unlucky, if you're not geared up enough- you might come upon the challenging boss chamber and do battle with one of 5 custom bossfights! 

Shrines can generate in any Overworld biome that isn't an ocean, beach, or river, and they're approximately as rare as Trial Chambers are. They have full compatibility with both Terralith and Cliff Under a Tree biomes as well! They consist of a surface entrance, a room with beds and chests to set your spawnpoint or store any junk, a main chamber containing trial spawners for a variety of mobs, and a vault room.

Your reward for slaying the Shrine's enemies is a Challenge Key, used to open the its vaults! Shrine vaults can reward you with one of 9 different enchantments.

<details>
<summary>Shrine Enchantments</summary>

- Flame Guard 1-3
  - Goes on armor
  - Attackers have a chance to be set ablaze
  - Mutually exclusive with Thorns
- Puncture 1-5
  - Goes on crossbows
  - Fired arrows ignore an amount of the victim's armor by 10% per level
  - Mutually exclusive with Piercing and Multishot
- Pathwalker
  - Goes on boots
  - Slightly increases movement speed when walking on path blocks
- Panic 1-3
  - Goes on boots
  - When hit, has a chance to grant Speed to the victim for 10 seconds
  - The level of Speed granted is the same as the enchantment level
- Relentless 1-3
  - Goes on melee weapons (swords, axes, trident, mace)
  - Increases the weapon's attack speed by 0.1 per level
- Rugged 1-3
  - Goes on leggings
  - Increases step height and movement efficiency
  - This means you can step up a full block (plus a little extra per level) and get slowed down less by blocks like soul sand
- Proficiency
  - Goes on tools
  - Increases block mining speed multiplier by 50%
- Extension
  - Goes on tools
  - Increases block interaction range by 2 blocks
- Reactive
  - Goes on shields
  - Blocking an attack creates a burst of wind
- Sturdy
  - Goes on all items with durability
  - Durability consumption is capped at 1 (the item will not lose extra durability for incorrect use)
- Thermal
  - Goes on chestplates
  - Provides immunity to magma blocks and powder snow 


</details>


Open up an Ominous Shrine vault with an Ominous Challenge Key, and you can get any of the regular Shrine Vault enchantments, plus an extra 8 more.

<details>
<summary>Ominous Shrine Enchantments</summary>

- Force 1-3
  - Goes on maces
  - Increases knockback for distance fallen when landing a smash attack
- Crush
  - Goes on maces
  - When landing a smash attack, inflicts Slowness 4 and Weakness on the victim for 5 seconds each
- Thunderstruck
  - Goes on maces
  - Strikes the victim with lightning when landing a smash attack from 10 blocks or higher while exposed to the sky
- Solar Veil
  - Goes on armor
  - Increases protection from damage when exposed to sunlight
  - Mutually exclusive with Lunar Ward
- Lunar Ward
  - Goes on armor
  - Increases protection from damage when exposed to moonlight
  - Mutually exclusive with Solar Veil
- Anti-Aerial 1-4
  - Goes on maces
  - Increases damage dealt to airborne mobs
  - Mutually exclusive with other damage-type enchantments (e.g. Breach and Density)
- Spearing 1-4
  - Goes on tridents
  - Increases attack range by 0.5 blocks per level
- Gale 1-3
  - Goes on tridents
  - Creates a burst of wind when the thrown trident hits a block or mob


</details>


1 in 4 shrines will be Boss Shrines, containing a single spawner for one of 5 unique Shrine Bosses.

<details>
<summary>Shrine Bosses</summary>

- Shrine Golem
  - A massive Iron Golem that attacks players on sight!
  - Has more health and moves faster when Ominous
- Zombie Rider
  - A pumpkin-wearing Zombie riding a Zombie Horse!
  - Spawns in a group of 3 when Ominous
- Illusioner
  - The famously unimplemented mob shows its face once more!
  - Creates a burst of wind if struck when Ominous
- The Killer Bunny
  - Don't be deceived, it bites!
  - Is smaller and moves faster when Ominous
- Silverfish Queen
  - A huge Silverfish that summons her subjects when hit!
  - Is larger and bulkier when Ominous


</details>


Defeating a Shrine Boss nets you a Boss Challenge Key- or Ominous Boss Challenge Key if you manage to take down the ominous version- which can open the Shrine Boss vaults, guaranteed to reward you with at least one Shrine enchantment! Can you defeat all the bosses and obtain every one of these special enchantments?

traders-shrine.title: Traders Shrine
traders-shrine.description: A centralized Villager Trading Hub for your Trading Halls. Features Bulk Trading, Upgrades and more QoL.
traders-shrine.body:
# Traders Shrine **The centralized Villager Trading Hub you never knew you ducking needed in your Trading Halls.** Tired of running between countless villagers to find that one trade? Or tired of Bulk trading? Place a Traders Shrine, and it automatically scans all nearby Villagers! Giving you access to every trade from a single, **clean interface**. --- ![statue](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qnRPa7yN/images/beeec32dc103cbb5096b1c3499787336c8462564.png) --- ## ✨ Features
### 📦 Trading Modes
**Single Trade Mode** > Browse through individual villagers, see their professions and levels, then pick specific trades. Great for when you need something particular. **Bulk Trade Mode** > Every trade from every villager in one list, sorted by cost. Find the cheapest mending book across all your librarians instantly. Buy in quantities of 16, 32, 64, or MAX!
### 🔍 Villager Detection - Automatically detects all villagers within range - Supports custom-named villagers (nametags work!) - Dynamic range that can be upgraded up to **50 blocks**
### ⬆️ Deep/Grindy Upgrade System Each shrine has its own progression. Invest resources to unlock: | Upgrade | What it does | |---------|-------------| | **Single Trade** | More trades before cooldown (up to 32) | | **Bulk Trade** | More bulk purchases before cooldown (up to 5) | | **Range** | Larger detection radius (6→50 blocks) | | **Multiplier** | Bonus output on trades (up to 2x) |
📊 Single Trade Upgrade Costs | Level | Trades | Cost | |-------|--------|------| | 1 | 8 → 10 | 16 Iron Blocks | | 2 | 10 → 12 | 24 Iron Blocks + 8 Redstone Blocks | | 3 | 12 → 14 | 32 Iron Blocks + 16 Redstone Blocks | | 4 | 14 → 16 | 16 Gold Blocks + 16 Quartz Blocks | | 5 | 16 → 20 | 24 Gold Blocks + 12 Amethyst Blocks + 1 Diamond Block | | 6 | 20 → 24 | 32 Gold Blocks + 24 Amethyst Blocks + 1 Diamond Block | | 7 | 24 → 28 | 24 Quartz Blocks + 16 Crying Obsidian + 2 Diamond Blocks | | 8 | 28 → 32 | 8 Amethyst Blocks + 4 Diamond Blocks + 4 Echo Shards | | MAX | 32 | 2 Nether Stars + 6 Diamond Blocks |
📊 Bulk Trade Upgrade Costs | Level | Trades | Cooldown | Cost | |-------|--------|----------|------| | 1 | 1 → 2 | 300s → 240s | 24 Copper Blocks + 16 Iron Blocks | | 2 | 2 → 3 | 240s → 180s | 32 Copper Blocks + 24 Iron Blocks + 2 Diamond Blocks | | 3 | 3 → 4 | 180s → 120s | 24 Gold Blocks + 16 Redstone Blocks + 2 Diamond Blocks | | 4 | 4 → 5 | 120s → 60s | 32 Gold Blocks + 16 Amethyst Blocks + 6 Diamond Blocks | | MAX | 5 | 60s | 10 Diamond Blocks + 8 Echo Shards + 1 Nether Star |
📊 Range Upgrade Costs | Level | Range | Cost | |-------|-------|------| | 1 | 6 → 10 | 8 Copper Blocks | | 2 | 10 → 14 | 16 Copper Blocks | | 3 | 14 → 18 | 8 Iron Blocks | | 4 | 18 → 22 | 16 Iron Blocks + 1 Diamond Block | | 5 | 22 → 26 | 8 Gold Blocks + 1 Diamond Block | | 6 | 26 → 30 | 16 Gold Blocks + 2 Diamond Blocks | | 7 | 30 → 34 | 12 Quartz Blocks + 8 Crying Obsidian | | 8 | 34 → 38 | 24 Quartz Blocks + 16 Crying Obsidian + 2 Diamond Blocks | | 9 | 38 → 42 | 12 Amethyst Blocks + 12 Quartz Blocks + 4 Diamond Blocks | | 10 | 42 → 46 | 24 Amethyst Blocks + 6 Diamond Blocks | | MAX | 46 → 50 | 8 Diamond Blocks + 6 Echo Shards + 1 Nether Star |
📊 Multiplier Upgrade Costs > **Note:** Multiplier unlocks after reaching level 3 on Bulk Trade. | Level | Multiplier | Cost | |-------|------------|------| | 1 | 1.0 → 1.1 | 16 Iron Blocks | | 2 | 1.1 → 1.2 | 32 Iron Blocks | | 3 | 1.2 → 1.3 | 16 Gold Blocks | | 4 | 1.3 → 1.4 | 24 Gold Blocks + 2 Diamond Blocks | | 5 | 1.4 → 1.5 | 16 Quartz Blocks + 16 Amethyst Blocks + 4 Diamond Blocks | | 6 | 1.5 → 1.6 | 32 Quartz Blocks + 32 Amethyst Blocks + 6 Diamond Blocks | | 7 | 1.6 → 1.7 | 8 Diamond Blocks + 4 Echo Shards | | 8 | 1.7 → 1.8 | 12 Diamond Blocks + 8 Echo Shards | | 9 | 1.8 → 1.9 | 16 Diamond Blocks + 12 Echo Shards | | MAX | 1.9 → 2.0 | 2 Nether Stars + 20 Diamond Blocks |
--- ## 🛡️ Multiplayer Ready - **Owner Protection**: Only the player who placed the shrine can access settings or destroy it - **Session Locking**: When someone's using a shrine, others can't interfere/open it - **Anti-Theft**: GUI items are protected — so, no stealing from the barrel --- ## 🛡️ QoL - **Nitwit converting**: Nitwits will get converted to normal Villagers after some time - **Villager Buffs**: Healing and Protection for your Villagers in case of accidents! --- ## 📋 How to 1. **Craft the Shrine** — Recipe below 2. **Place it** — Find a spot with vertical clearance (Shrines are 3 blocks tall) 3. **Bring Villagers** — Any villagers within range get detected automatically 4. **Right-click the Shrine** — Open the trading interface/shrine menu 5. **Trade & Upgrade** — Build up your shrine over time
![Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/qnRPa7yN/images/4c2ee7eebe9b56ceb9e458e8b5c43251719938b1.png) --- ## ❓ FAQ **Can I pick up and move a shrine?** > Yes! Break it as the owner, and you'll get the shrine item back with all upgrades preserved. **Does it work with cured villagers?** > Absolutely. Any villager with trades works. (Not Wandering Traders) **What if two players try to use the same shrine?** > The second player gets blocked until the first one closes the menu. **Can I have multiple shrines?** > Yes, each shrine is independent with its own upgrades and range. --- ### **Join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/rXnr7XHRg8) server for Bug reports or feature suggestions :)**

revival-lives-shrine.title: Revival Shrine & Lives System
revival-lives-shrine.description: Every player gets 10 lives. Lose them all and you're stuck in spectator mode — unless your friends build a shrine to bring you back.
revival-lives-shrine.body:
# Revival Lives Shrine

**Revival Lives Shrine** adds a hardcore-lite lives system to your survival server. Every player starts with **10 lives** — each death costs one. When you run out, you're locked in **Spectator Mode** until a friend builds a **Revival Altar** to bring you back.

## 💀 The Lives System

* Every player begins with **10 lives** (configurable).
* Each death removes one life with a warning in chat.
* At **zero lives**, you're permanently stuck in Spectator Mode.
* Lives persist through server restarts and work with **offline-mode / TLauncher**.
* **Visual HUD**: Your lives are displayed as hearts in the top-right corner. Hearts change color based on health: **Red** (4+), **Orange** (1–3), and **Grey** (0).

## 🏝️ Soul Nexus Sky Islands

The world now features **Soul Nexus Sky Islands**, floating high-altitude islands (Y=180+) that are essential for revival.

* **Soul Crystals**: These islands are covered in Soul Crystal blocks, which are required for crafting.
* **Rare Structures**: Some islands spawn with Ritual Pedestals and Shrines already placed.
* **Accessing Islands**: Create a **Soul Portal** by placing a **Soul Crystal** inside a 3x3 frame of **Amethyst Blocks**.

## 🏛️ The Revival Altar (New Ritual)

Revival is no longer just a single block; it is a **multiblock ritual**.

### 🔨 New Crafting Recipes

*All mod blocks require a **Diamond Pickaxe** or better to mine.*

* **Soul Crystal**: Crafted with 4 Amethyst Shards, 4 Echo Shards, and 1 Soul Lantern.
* **Ritual Pedestal**: Crafted with 4 Obsidian (corners), 4 Crying Obsidian (cross), and 1 Soul Crystal (center).
* **Revival Shrine**: Crafted with 4 Obsidian (corners), 4 Soul Crystals (cross), and 1 Nether Star (center).

### ⚡ Activating the Shrine

To revive a player, you must build the altar layout:

1. **Place the Revival Shrine** in the center.
2. **Place 4 Ritual Pedestals** on the cardinal sides (North, South, East, West) directly adjacent to the shrine.
3. **Offerings**: Right-click each pedestal with one of the following items:
* 1× Nether Star
* 1× Totem of Undying
* 1× Beacon
* 1× Enchanted Golden Apple


4. **Activation**: Right-click the Shrine with an empty hand. A **60-second timer** and a golden beacon will appear.
5. **Resurrection**: Click a dead player's name in chat or use the revive command. The player is reset to 10 lives, switches to Survival, and teleports to the shrine, which then self-destructs.

## ⌨️ Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/revivallivesshrine help` | Everyone | Shows mod guide & all commands |
| `/revivallivesshrine lives` | Everyone | Check your remaining lives |
| `/revivallivesshrine revive <player>` | Everyone | Revive a player (needs active shrine) |
| `/revivallivesshrine admin revive <player>` | **OP 2+** | Force-revive without a shrine |

## ⚙️ Configuration

Edit `config/revivallivesshrine.json` to change the starting life count:

```json
{
    "defaultLives": 10
}

```

## 📦 Requirements

* **Minecraft** 1.21.8
* **Fabric Loader** 0.16.0+
* **Fabric API** for 1.21.8
* **Java** 21+

trial-shrine.description: a mod adding challenges to get heart back from losing it via mediumcore while being the same difficuty no matter what gear you have.
trial-shrine.body:
**A non gear based challenge to gain hearts back after death**

Instead of regaining hearts by simply eating a golden / enchanted golden apple, hearts are recovered through a one-time, structure-based challenge:

**The mod adds a new world structure** that can be located using an eye-like item (crafted with a specific block) that points to the structure.

Each structure acts as a Trial Shrine that teleports you into a Cataclysm arena and makes you fight its boss _**(L_Ender’s Cataclysm is required).**_

To keep the difficulty consistent for everyone, the shrine provides a temporary kit designed to:

**preserve the intended boss experience, and**

**make the fight fair regardless of your prior gear or progression.**

The kit is wiped when you clear the arena or die, so you can’t farm or carry the equipment out.

Each shrine is accessible only once per player, permanently—disconnecting, dying, or returning later won’t reset your eligibility.

The result: heart recovery stays meaningful and equally challenging throughout the entire playthrough, instead of becoming trivial once you’re geared.

hardcoresoulshrines.title: HardcoreSoulShrines
hardcoresoulshrines.description: HardcoreSoulShrines is a plugin designed for Hardcore servers where death is meant to be meaningful but not necessarily final. Buy back your fallen friend from a special shrine.
hardcoresoulshrines.body:
## HardcoreSoulShrines

![gif](https://i.imgur.com/OhtqSJN.gif)

**HardcoreSoulShrines** brings permanent death back into Hardcore Minecraft by letting alive players revive fallen friends at magical shrines using diamonds or another materials.

### About

**HardcoreSoulShrines** is a plugin designed for **Hardcore** servers where death is meant to be meaningful but not necessarily final.   

Admins can easily place shrines anywhere on the map, while players use them to bring back their fallen friends. The plugin keeps the hardcore spirit alive with increasing revival costs based on death count and full control over what happens after revival.

Perfect for **Hardcore SMPs**, roleplay servers, and any community that wants high-stakes gameplay with a fair chance at redemption.

### Features

- Admins can create shrines using **/shrine create [name]** (placed on a configurable block type such as beacon)
- Right-clicking a shrine opens a GUI showing all currently dead hardcore players
- Each soul entry displays the player’s name, total death count, and current revival cost
- Revival cost automatically increases with each death
- Living players can pay the cost in **diamons** or any configured materials to instantly revive the chosen player
- Revived players respawn at the shrine location with optional item restoration.
- Completely dead players are saved in the graveyard tab as a memory.

### Commands

```yaml
commands:
  shrine:
    description: Main command for HardcoreSoulShrines.
    usage: /shrine <create [name...]|remove|list|check|force-revive|reload>
    permission: hardcoresoulshrines.admin
  shrinereload:
    description: Reload HardcoreSoulShrines configuration.
    usage: /shrinereload
    permission: hardcoresoulshrines.admin
```

### Permissions

```yaml
permissions:
  hardcoresoulshrines.admin:
    description: Allows managing shrines and reloading the plugin.
    default: op
```

### Support

**If you find a bug, have an idea, or need help - join the Discord server.**

tensuradungeon.title: Tensura:Dungeon
tensuradungeon.description: Tensura: Dungeon expands on Tensura Reincarnated by introducing a full dungeon system inspired by Rimuru’s Labyrinth. Explore a procedurally generated dungeon filled with traps, shrine trials, rare mobs, and boss fights — all tied into a progression-based
tensuradungeon.body: ## Support The Dungeon [Click here to support on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/TRBeyond) ![Tensura Dungeon Logo](https://i.imgur.com/kLan8F0.jpeg) *** ## About the Add-On **Tensura: Dungeon** expands on **Tensura Reincarnated** by introducing a full dungeon system inspired by Rimuru’s Labyrinth. Explore a procedurally generated dungeon filled with traps, shrine trials, rare mobs, and boss fights — all tied into a progression-based loot system. The current release includes 10 unique floors, with more planned in future updates. We’ll be expanding the dungeon over time to add new content, new challenges, and even deadlier encounters. *** ## How to Enter * **Find a Cartographer** – 50% chance they’ll sell a Dungeon Map for 2 emeralds * **Right-click the map** to reveal coordinates to the Colosseum (your dungeon entrance) * **Pay 3 Silver Coins** or use a Dungeon Voucher from the Dryad to enter *** ## Server Setup Tips * Disable mob griefing for smoother gameplay: `/gamerule mobGriefing false` * In `server.properties`, set: `max-tick-time=180000` **If the dungeon generation breaks or glitches:** 1. Go to your world folder → `dimensions` → delete the `trbeyond` folder 2. Run: /cleardungeon /createdungeon 100 0.75 0.6 yaml Copy Edit *** ## Commands / Configs / Gamerules ### Commands `/cleardungeon` – Wipes the current dungeon `/createdungeon 100 0.75 0.6` – Generates a new dungeon `/dungeon summonelite` – Summons a unique monster *** ### Gamerules `/gamerule colosseumGeneration true/false` Toggles generation of the Colosseum. `/gamerule nightmareMode true/false` All bosses gain: • All Resistances • All Bosses are unique • Resistance Shred • Anti-Skill Effects • Disabled Flight (includes race-based flight) • Spatial Movement Disabled `/gamerule mobsSpawnWithDungeon true/false` Controls if mobs automatically spawn with dungeon structure generation. `/gamerule uniqueMonsterChance [value]` Sets the chance for mobs to spawn as Unique Monsters. `/gamerule lootExplosionChance [value]` Adjusts the chance for chests to trigger a loot explosion on open. `/gamerule dungeonfloorsize [number]` Number of dungeon pieces per floor. Default: 100 `/gamerule ambientmobspawnrate [value]` Reduces the ambient mob spawn rate around players inside the dungeon. `/gamerule uniqueMonsterOverworld true/false` Toggles the spawning of Unique Monsters in the overworld. `/gamerule uniqueMonsterParticles true/false` Toggles the particle effects on Unique Monsters for easier visibility. *** ### Configs * `Boss stats` – All boss stats are configurable * `trapSpawnChance` – Sets the overall chance for traps to generate * `maxPlayersInDungeon` – Limit how many players can be in the dungeon at once * `dungeonReentryCooldown` – Cooldown before a player can re-enter the dungeon * `disableSkillsInDungeon` – List of skill IDs or categories to disable during dungeon runs * `npcShopConfigs` – Set which NPCs sell items in the dungeon shop/lobby * `coinReplacement` – Replace Bronze/Silver/Gold/Stellar Coins with custom items or values * `chestRefreshTimers` – Set timers for how often dungeon chests refresh * `specialMobSpawnChances` – Configure rare mob spawn chances (like Dungeon Dominators) * `disablechallenges` – Turns off dungeon challenges *** ## Trailer ## New Update *** ## Join the Community [![Discord Logo](https://img.icons8.com/color/48/000000/discord-logo.png)](https://discord.gg/MBCcx479yc) [![YouTube Logo](https://img.icons8.com/color/48/000000/youtube-play.png)](https://www.youtube.com/@TR-Beyond)

trolldom.title: trolldom
trolldom.description: Adds four elemental shrines that generates in the world, performing certain tasks at the shrines grants elemental boons which lasts until death.
trolldom.body:
## Introduction
Adds four elemental shrines that generates in the world, performing certain tasks at the shrines grants elemental boons which lasts until death.

![Hero image showing all elemental shrines](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gu9PQOOc/images/c0f1e97a3e32f4a224c0a851b73a5b8720be2334.png)

## Shrines & Boons
You can check the advancements for information on where to find the shrines and how to gain the boons, once you've gained a boon you can open your inventory and place your cursor over the effect to get more information about what it does. The information below is the same as what's available in-game, except for some smaller tips.

Breaking the blocks that make up a shrine is likely to ruin the shrine, if you want to create a build around a shrine I'd suggest experimenting in creative first. You can spawn in the shrines with the /place command, type in "/place trolldom:" and you should be able to figure out the rest from the autocomplete suggestions.

 

## Fire
![Fire shrine charging up](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gu9PQOOc/images/cfc7109ad6079c0739a28806e3a92a169c373239.gif)

Fire shrines can be found in the nether, they appear as spires that span the full height between the floor and the ceiling of the nether. The shrines can generate anywhere but will likely be easier to find in large open areas.

To gain the fire boon the player needs to find the center of the spire, there should be a gap in the central pillar surrounded by four braziers in each of the cardinal directions. Place and light flammable blocks in each of the braziers, coal blocks or something that burns for a longer duration are preferable. Bring some extra flammable blocks in case a brazier burns out before the ritual finishes, if all braziers burn out before the ritual is complete it will reset and one must start over.

The fire boon grants +30% attack speed and mining speed for 30 seconds whenever a nearby entity takes fire damage. Holds up to 7 charges, hitting an entity or breaking a block removes a charge.

 

## Earth
![Player meditating at an earth shrine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gu9PQOOc/images/0c90754b6c08cb0d1919dfc79350a2923f32146f.gif)

Earth shrines can be found in the overworld, at the intersection of the deepslate and stone strata. The shrines are typically riddled with ore, but mining the ore is likely to ruin the shrine.

To gain the earth boon the player needs to meditate (crouch + stand still) on top of the central chunk of the shrine for a few seconds.

The earth boon grants a 4 point absorption shield, the shield replenishes after 10 seconds of not taking damage.

Note: This will likely be expanded upon later to allow the player to draw power from different types of stone while having the boon.

 

## Water
![Player swimming through the first gate of a water shrine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gu9PQOOc/images/54d00fd833e655cbe6da818d8a77f683de1a3cd3.gif)


Water shrines can be found in deep oceans, each shrine consists of five gates laid out in a path.

To gain the water boon the player needs to swim through all five gates in under a minute.

The water boon grants +0.05 attack damage and -0.5% mining speed when attacking an entity, or the reverse when breaking blocks (triggers every 10th block). This effect stacks up to 60 times in either direction.

 

## Air
![Player looking at an air shrine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gu9PQOOc/images/aefaa550e6aa7df04ae7c15e1dc10122f8267ef3.gif)

Air shrines can be found in mountains, badlands, hills, savannas and plains. A strong wind blows over the shrine, look at the banners around the shrine to discern the wind's direction. With proper positioning and view angle the player can ride the draft into the air or greatly propel themselves forward with an elytra.

To gain the air boon the player must ride the draft for six seconds without landing, although quickly pushing oneself off the ground after landing might slip the notice of the wind sprites.

The air boon grants +15% movement speed and the player can press ctrl + space to grant themselves the draft effect in the closest cardinal direction for a few seconds.

 

## Licensing & use
Feel free to use this in modpacks or compilations as long as it's distributed through modrinth.

 

## Discord
I've got a discord server over here: https://discord.gg/MyjK4Fx, jump on if you have questions, need some help or to get sneak-peeks at upcoming features.

 

## Support and Contributions
This is a pretty new mod and I'd be super happy if you could try your best to break it as much as you possibly can and submit bug reports using the issue tracker link in the nav above.


I develop and maintain my mods in my spare time, if you enjoy what you've seen so far and want to help me to create more experiences please consider supporting me on patreon.

# 🔥 Nether's Trial 🔥

***

### The Nether hides more than lava seas and blazing fortresses… 

Scattered across its depths are three mysterious teleport shrines – each one spawns naturally and leads to a different dungeon difficulty.

Inside awaits:

*   ⚔️ Three custom Ravager bosses
*   🔧 Redstone contraptions & hidden traps
*   🏃 Parkour segments to keep you on your toes
*   💡 Dark corridors & atmospheric lighting
*   🛑 In-dungeon respawn enabled by default – no more long walks back
*   💎 Custom loot rewards, including:  
      - ⚔️ The ultimate slayer sword  
      - 🛡️ God’s Protection – a divine potion  
      - 🦾 Warrior & Beast Slayer armor sets

**Every run feels unique**  
**Explore, fight, and prove yourself in the Nether’s most dangerous trial.**

💀 Remember, warrior… every journey comes with a price:

*   **Easy:** 2 Netherite Scrap / 4 Players MAX / 60min cooldown
*   **Normal:** 4 Netherite Scrap / 6 Players MAX / 1,5h cooldown
*   **Hard:** 2 Netherite Ingot / 8 Players MAX / 2h cooldown

legacy-of-the-ancients.body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f2b76513b1fe58832fe116b0424edc1c6d637575_0.webp)mod aimed at adding new structures and unique interactions with shrines and altars

currently the mod is not fully finished and is in active development, the creation of such a mod requires more understanding of specific situations of interaction with structures in the game by different players and any criticism and feedback are welcome

currently adds:
- 5 ancient altar structures
- 3 forest shrine structures
- 3 cosmic structures
- 4 dune structures
- 4 different altars (saturation altar, luck altar, trial altar, spirit workshop)
- 2 different forest shrines (forest shrine, cleansing fountain)
- 3 different sacred fruitful trees
- 2 altars of hot lands

also adds 3 fully developed mobs for ancient altars, and 2 followers of sacred forests, 2 vanguard mobs, 3 metalized mob

includes many different items of tools, armor and several swords but does not focus on the RPG component and most of the items have a **non-combat idea**

basically all types of structures are also good ways to accumulate experience, but in different parts of the world you can find radically different structures protected by different unique creatures

some of the simplest structures can be found around the world as **cosmic shrines** of the moon, sun and stars

**only the moon and sun** can have different blessings in the form of temporary effects, at the cost of the fact that after receiving the effect you will temporarily not be able to be either in the dark or in the light, depending on the altar where the blessing was acquired

also **only at the moon shrine** you can activate the invasion of the lunar legion after you find 3 relics from the creatures of the sacred forest, which will allow stronger enemies to appear during the night, and will also affect some plants and creatures

**only at the sun shrine** you can gain a blessing that will allow you to accumulate experience gained during the blessing and gain it again after re-worshiping the shrine

**only at the altar of the stars** you can set up a teleportation system between others altars of stars due to experience and the key responsible for the place where you are going to teleport

in the vastness of fields and plains you can find **altars and workshops** of the **ancients**, which are **protected** by the collected defenders, there you can find 4 different altars responsible for different aspects of the game

**altar of luck** as the simplest gives a chance to get unique ancient artifacts and tools of the ancients due to jewelry

**altar of saturation** gives rewards for making sacrifices prepared in advance by rituals, and also gives gifts in the form of temporary effects for the provided offerings of food

**altar of trials** provides an opportunity to show strength and skills in trials for a reward

**forge of spirits** allows you to turn tools and armor into effects and artifacts of the ancients, donated items turn into a wave of enemies after some use

**forest sanctuaries** are already in the dying forgotten corners of the forests, you can find rare powerful plants with their fruits, guarded by followers altars also provide more ways to gain experience for caring for the forest

**ancient corruption** and ruins of the ancients can still be useful and dangerous

ascendcore.title: Ascend
ascendcore.description: A progression mod that adds leveling, attributes, knowledge and mystical shrines.
ascendcore.body:
# Ascend

Ascend is a soulslike RPG progression mod inspired by *Deepwoken* and *Elden Ring*. 

Ascend works as a standalone mod, with optional integrations for **Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks** and **Mind & Motion**.

## Progression
Combat, crafting, mining, and exploration award **Ascend XP**. Gaining an Ascend Level grants attribute points that can be invested through the Ascend Stats screen.

By default:
- The maximum Ascend Level is 20.
- Each level grants 15 attribute points.
- Attributes can be raised to 100.
  - (Higher attribute investments provide diminishing returns)

Press **V** to open the Ascend Stats screen. The key can be changed under **Controls → Keybinds → Inventory**.

## Attributes

Build your character using eight attributes:

| Attribute | Effects |
| --- | --- |
| **Vigor** | Increases maximum health. |
| **Mind** | Increases mana capacity and mana regeneration with Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks. |
| **Strength** | Improves Strength-scaling weapons, attack knockback, and armor penetration. |
| **Agility** | Improves agile and ranged weapons while increasing movement speed. |
| **Intelligence** | Increases spell power and reduces spell cooldowns with Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks. |
| **Willpower** | Reduces spell cast time with Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks and improves Sanity and Tempo capacity with Mind & Motion. |
| **Charisma** | Improves villager prices and reputation while strengthening nearby tamed allies. With Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks, it also improves holy magic and summons. |
| **Arcane** | Extends beneficial effects on yourself and harmful effects you inflict on enemies. |

## Weapon Scaling

Weapons have attribute-scaling grades ranging from **E to S**. A weapon’s tooltip shows which attributes improve its damage and how strongly it scales with each one.

Heavy weapons generally favor Strength, while faster and ranged weapons tend to favor Agility. Some weapons benefit from both, allowing you to create specialized or hybrid builds.

Strength-scaling weapons can also penetrate part of an enemy’s armor.

## Knowledge

**Knowledge** is a rare progression currency.

You can earn it by:
- Gaining Ascend Levels.
- Defeating creatures with 150 health or more.
- Reading a **Moonseye Tome**, which grants a large amount of Knowledge.

## Shrine of Remembrance

Rare Shrines of Remembrance can be discovered throughout the world. Spend Knowledge at a shrine to reset your invested attribute points and create a new build.

When **Mind & Motion** is installed, the shrine also offers special interactions involving Sanity and Knowledge.

## Optional Mod Compatibility

### Iron’s Spells ’n Spellbooks
Adds mana, spell power, mana regeneration, cooldown reduction, cast-time reduction, holy magic, and summon bonuses to the relevant Ascend attributes.

### Mind & Motion
Connects Willpower to its mental resources and adds additional choices to the Shrine of Remembrance.

Neither mod is required to play Ascend.

## Configuration
Progression speed, level limits, points per level, attribute caps, bonuses, weapon-scaling grades, soft caps, and many other gameplay values can be customized in:

`config/ascend-common.toml`

farmers-miracle.body:
## 🌾 Farmer's Miracle - Collect Sacred Orbs, Bless Your Crops

**Explore temples, gather three sacred orbs, and permanently boost your crop growth!**

Farmer's Miracle adds three unique temple structures to your world, each containing a collectible orb. Gather all three orbs to unlock permanent crop growth buffs that affect nearby crops as you farm.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🏛️ 3 Temple Structures
- **Temple of Golden Wheat** — A shrine dedicated to wheat, hidden in the wilderness
- **Temple of Pumpkins** — A temple celebrating the pumpkin harvest
- **Temple of Melons** — A tropical temple honoring melons
- All temples generate within 2000 blocks of the initial spawn point
- Minimum 300+ blocks distance between temples
- Found in plains, forests, taigas, savannas, meadows, and more

### 🔮 Collectible Orbs
Each temple chest contains a unique orb:
- **Wheat Orb** — from the Temple of Golden Wheat
- **Pumpkin Orb** — from the Temple of Pumpkins
- **Melon Orb** — from the Temple of Melons

### 🏆 Advancements
- Triggered by obtaining each orb
- A final advancement for collecting all three orbs

### 🌱 Permanent Crop Growth Buffs
Each advancement grants **"Blessing of Grains"** buffs:
- **Growth I–IV**: Increases crop growth speed (stacks with each orb collected, +3% per level)
- **Spread I**: Expands buff range from 16 to 24 blocks (granted by collecting all 3 orbs)
- **Target crops**: Wheat, Pumpkin, Melon, Potato, Carrot, Beetroot
- Buffs are permanent and persist across sessions

### 🤝 Mod Compatibility
Crop growth buffs also apply to grain and vegetable crops from the following mods (no additional setup required):
- **Farmer's Delight** (`farmersdelight`) — Cabbages, Onions, Tomatoes, Rice
- **Croptopia** (`croptopia`) — Barley, Corn, Oat, Rice, and many more vegetables
- **Pam's HarvestCraft 2 - Crops** (`pamhc2crops`) — Barley, Corn, Rice, Rye, and many more vegetables
- **Cultural Delights** (`culturaldelights`) — Corn, Cucumbers, Eggplants

> **Note**: Only grain and vegetable crops are included by default. Fruits, herbs, and beverages are not covered. You can add support for additional crops or mods by creating a datapack that appends entries to the `farmersmiracle:grains` block tag.

---

## 📖 How to Play

1. **Explore the World**: Search for temples near the world spawn
2. **Find the Temples**: Look for the three unique temple structures in various biomes
3. **Collect the Orbs**: Open the chest in each temple to obtain its orb
4. **Earn Advancements**: Each orb triggers an advancement and grants a crop growth buff
5. **Collect All Three**: Gathering all three orbs unlocks the maximum buff level and expanded range
6. **Farm with Power**: Enjoy permanently boosted crop growth around you!

---

## 🛠️ Technical Details

### Multi-Loader Support
This mod supports **multiple mod loaders and versions**!
- **Fabric** and **NeoForge** for Minecraft 1.21.11
- **Fabric** and **NeoForge** for Minecraft 1.21.10
- **Fabric** and **NeoForge** for Minecraft 1.21.9

- Download the correct version for your mod loader
- Shared codebase ensures consistent experience across loaders

### Requirements

#### Minecraft 1.21.11
- **Mod Loader**:
  - Fabric Loader 0.17.3+ with Fabric API 0.141.3+1.21.11, OR
  - NeoForge 21.11.38-beta+

### Compatibility
- Works alongside other world generation mods
- Compatible with performance mods (Sodium, Starlight, etc.)
- No conflicts with other mods — uses only vanilla blocks for structures
- Built-in crop support for Farmer's Delight, Croptopia, Pam's HarvestCraft 2, and Cultural Delights (these mods are **not required**)
