divinity-economy.title: Divinity Economy (Global Market)
divinity-economy.description: A global dynamic market with the ability to buy and sell every item, enchants and experience in the game, and scales with supply and demand. A truly revolutionary and unique plugin packed with tons of features.
divinity-economy.body:
🌟 Introducing DivinityEconomy: The Next Generation of Minecraft Economy Plugins 🌟

DivinityEconomy is a revolutionary Minecraft plugin 🛠️ that offers an immersive and customizable in-game economy experience 💰 for servers running Bukkit or Spigot. Building on the legacy of HyperConomy, DivinityEconomy incorporates a range of advanced features that cater to the diverse needs of server owners and players alike.

🚀 Check It Out (Official Server Links)

    Discord: Click To Join

    Minecraft Server Java: DivinityCraft.org:25565

    Dynmap: Click To View

    Website Click To View

    Report A Bug: Click To Report

    bStats: Click To View

🔑 Key Features

  • 📊 Dynamic Market System: DivinityEconomy boasts a sophisticated market system that adjusts item prices based on supply and demand. Server owners have the option to disable this feature if desired. Additionally, the plugin supports item damage scaling 🔧 to further enhance the realism of the in-game economy.

  • 📚 Extensive Item Support:The plugin supports the purchase and sale of every item in the game. Every block. Every potion. Every spawner. Every enchant. And even player experience.

  • 💸 Customizable Taxation and Fees: The plugin allows server owners to set up custom taxes and fees for various transactions, such as buying, selling, or trading items. This feature provides more control over the economy's structure and encourages strategic financial decision-making among players.

  • 💡 Easy Command System: DivinityEconomy features a user-friendly command system that includes essential commands for seamless player-to-player economic interactions. This streamlined interface ensures a smooth and enjoyable experience for all users.

  • 🚀 Instant Tab Completion: The plugin offers instant tab completion for all players and items, including hundreds of thousands of item name aliases. This feature allows users to quickly access item valuations without having to press enter, resulting in a more efficient and satisfying experience.

  • 🎨 Customizable Items, Prices, and Aliases: DivinityEconomy provides server owners with the flexibility to customize items, prices, and aliases to better suit their server's unique needs. This feature allows for the creation of a truly personalized in-game economy.

  • 🔐 Market Segment and Item Control: The plugin enables server owners to enable or disable specific market segments, individual items, and commands, giving them complete control over the in-game economy. This feature ensures that the economy can be tailored to suit the preferences and requirements of each server.

  • 🌍 Per-World Customisation: DivinityEconomy supports per-world customisation, allowing server owners to configure the economy differently in each world. This feature provides greater flexibility and control over the in-game economy, enabling server owners to create unique and engaging experiences for players.

  • 🔖 PlaceholderAPI Support: DivinityEconomy offers optional support for PlaceholderAPI, a plugin that allows server administrators to customize information displayed to players using placeholders. This feature enhances the plugin's customisation possibilities and versatility, enabling server owners to develop even more captivating and immersive economic experiences.

DivinityEconomy is designed to provide a highly customizable and immersive economic experience for Minecraft players 🎮. With its advanced features and user-friendly interface, this plugin is set to elevate the in-game economy to new levels, offering an engaging and interactive experience for all users.

😎 Other Noteworth Features

  • Ordered Balances with /baltop
  • User Mail System with /mailread to view balance notifications.
  • Pre-balanced economy setup for survival servers with 'inaccessible' items banned.
  • Pre-allocated thousands of item aliases.
  • QoL and Admin commands to setup features without touching config files.
  • Support for multiple languages.

📚 Localisation

DivinityEconomy supports localisation for multiple languages, this includes multiple options to enable language support for both commands and items, materials, enchantments and potions. You can also add your own language files, or tweak existing ones. If you would like to contribute to the localisation of DivinityEconomy, please visit our Discord.

Languages Currently Supported:
  • English.
  • French.
  • Spanish.
  • German.
  • Italian.
  • Russian.
  • Portuguese
  • Dutch
  • Polish
  • Danish
  • Swedish
  • Turkish
  • Chinese (Simplified)
  • Japanese
  • Arabic
  • Hebrew
  • Hindi
  • Korean
  • Ukrainian
  • Brazilian Portuguese

💾 Vault Dependency 💾

DivinityEconomy is reliant on the renowned plugin Vault. Vault is a necessity for DivinityEconomy's functionality, enabling seamless integration amongst various economy plugins 🔁. DivinityEconomy offers full Vault support, including support for player balances and bank accounts, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of plugins and features.

Acquire Vault Here 📥

⌨ Commands

💰 Money

  • Balance - See your own or others balances.
  • Pay - Send money to others.
  • ListBalances - View a list of players by player balance.

💰 Item Market

  • Buy - Buy an amount of an item from the market.
  • Sell - Sell an amount of an item from your inventory to the market.
  • Value - Get the purchase and sale value of an amount of an item.
  • Hand Buy - Buy an amount of the item that you are currently holding.
  • Hand Sell - Sell an amount of the item that you are currently holding.
  • Hand Value - Get the purchase and sale value of the item that you are currently holding.
  • Item Info - Get the market information for an item.
  • Item List - A comprehensive and advanced command that allows the user to query the item database for items by name, and order them with custom ascending/descending ordering types.
  • Sell All - A comphrensive and advanced command that allows the user to sell a list of whitelisted/blacklisted items from their inventory, in one command.

💥 Enchant Market

  • Enchant Hand Buy - Purchase enchants at the desired level for the item that you are currently holding.
  • Enchant Hand Sell - Sell enchants at the desired level from the item that you are currently holding.
  • Enchant Hand Value - Get the purchase and sale value of the enchants on the item that you are currently holding.
  • Enchant Value - Get the purchase and sale value of an enchant at the desired level.
  • Enchant Info - Get the market information for an enchant.
  • Enchant Sell All - A comphrensive and advanced command that allows the user to sell a list of whitelisted/blacklisted enchants from their inventory, in one command.

💫 Experience Market

  • Experience Buy - Purchase experience levels.
  • Experience Sell - Sell experience levels.

💡 Misc Commands

  • Read Mail - Read your economy notifications to track how your balance changes whilst offline.
  • Clear Mail - Clear your economy notifications.
  • Help - Command help, parameters, aliases and usage.
  • Ping - Pong!
  • EconomyNotifications - Toggle economy notifications on join and world change.

👷‍♂️ Admin Commands

  • Set Value - Set the value of an item within the market.
  • Set Stock - Set the stock of an item within the market.
  • Enchant Set Value - Set the value of an enchant within the market.
  • Enchant Set Stock - Set the stock of an enchant within the market.
  • Ban Item - Ban an item from the market.
  • Ban Enchant - Ban an enchant from the market.
  • Set Balance - Set the balance of a player.
  • Edit Balance - Edit the balance of a player by an amount, supporting both positive and negative numbers.
  • Clear Balance - A shorthand command for setting a players balance to 0.
  • Reload - Reload the enchants, items or config.
  • Save - Save the enchants or items to disk.

💾 Vault Dependency 💾

DivinityEconomy is reliant on the renowned plugin Vault. Vault is a necessity for DivinityEconomy's functionality, enabling seamless integration amongst various economy plugins 🔁
Acquire Vault Here 📥

🔖 PlaceholderAPI Support

Our plugin fully integrates with PlaceholderAPI, a plugin that allows server administrators to customize information displayed to players using placeholders. Please note that PlaceholderAPI is a separate plugin that must be installed. Download Here.

  • %de_material_inflation% - Displays the inflation rate for materials in the market.
  • %de_material_total_quantity% - Displays the total quantity of all materials currently in the market.
  • %de_material_total__default_quantity% - Displays the default total quantity of all materials in the market.
  • %de_enchant_inflation% - Displays the inflation rate for enchantments in the market.
  • %de_enchant_total_quantity% - Displays the total quantity of all enchantments currently in the market.
  • %de_enchant_total_default_quantity% - Displays the default total quantity of all enchantments in the market.
  • %de_format_money_{valueToFormat}% - Returns a formatted money value. This supports variables such as format_money_{placeholderapi_variable}.
  • %de_balance_math_{expression}_{value}% - Returns the result of the specified mathematical operation on the player's balance. For example, math_+_1000 returns the player's balance plus 1000.
  • %de_raw_balance_math_{expression}_{value}% - Returns the raw result of the specified mathematical operation on the player's balance.
  • %de_raw_player_balance% - Displays the raw value of the player's balance.
  • %de_player_balance% - Displays the player's balance in a formatted manner.
  • %de_material_SValue_{materialName}_{amount}% - Returns the formatted sell value of the specified quantity of a material.
  • %de_material_BValue_{materialName}_{amount}% - Returns the formatted buy value of the specified quantity of a material.
  • %de_raw_material_SValue_{materialName}_{amount}% - Returns the raw sell value of the specified quantity of a material.
  • %de_raw_material_BValue_{materialName}_{amount}% - Returns the raw buy value of the specified quantity of a material.
  • %de_material_stock_{materialName}% - Returns the current stock quantity of a specific material.
  • %de_enchant_stock_{enchantName}% - Returns the current stock quantity of a specific enchantment.
  • %de_material_stack_{materialName}% - Returns the maximum stack size for a specific material.
  • %de_exp_BValue_{amount}% - Returns the formatted buy value of the specified quantity of experience.
  • %de_exp_SValue_{amount}% - Returns the formatted sell value of the specified quantity of experience.
  • %de_market_enabled_worlds% - Returns a list of enabled worlds for the market.
  • %de_economy_enabled_worlds% - Returns a list of enabled worlds for the economy.
  • %de_market_disabled_worlds% - Returns a list of disabled worlds for the market.
  • %de_economy_disabled_worlds% - Returns a list of disabled worlds for the economy.
  • %de_market_enabled_world_{worldName}% - Returns true if the market is enabled in the given world.
  • %de_economy_enabled_world_{worldName}% - Returns true if the economy is enabled in the given world.
  • %de_market_enabled% - Returns true if the market is enabled in the current world.
  • %de_economy_enabled% - Returns true if the economy is enabled in the current world.
  • %de_hand_value_total% - Returns the total value of the item in the player's hand.
  • %de_hand_value_material% - Returns the material value of the item in the player's hand.
  • %de_hand_value_enchant% - Returns the enchant value of the item in the player's hand.

Please ensure that your PlaceholderAPI plugin is up-to-date to guarantee compatibility with our plugin. If you encounter any issues or require additional placeholders, do not hesitate to open an issue on our Github.

viscriptshop-market.title: ViScriptShop Market
viscriptshop-market.description: A player-driven marketplace mod that lets players create shops, list items in bundles, and trade with each other using ViScriptShop currency.
viscriptshop-market.body:
# VSS Market

VSS Market is a player marketplace add-on for ViScriptShop. It provides a server-wide market where players can create their own shops, list items for sale, and trade with each other using ViScriptShop coins.

## Features

### Player Shops

- Each player can own one shop with a customizable name.
- Sellers list items in **bundles** — define how many items per bundle and how many bundles in stock.
  - For example: list 5 wool per bundle with 3 bundles in stock. The system deducts 15 wool from the seller, and each buyer purchase gives them one bundle of 5 wool.
- Earnings from sales go into the shop's balance. The shop owner can collect coins anytime from the management panel.

### For Sellers

- **Create & Rename** — Set up a shop and change its name at any time.
- **List Items** — Choose an item from your inventory, set the price per bundle, bundle size, and stock quantity.
- **Restock** — Add more bundles to an existing listing.
- **Change Price** — Adjust the price of any listed item.
- **Take Down** — Remove a listing and get all remaining stock back.
- **Delete Shop** — Remove the entire shop. All remaining items and uncollected earnings are returned.
- Compatible with extended containers such as Refined Backpack and Beyond Dimensions.

### For Buyers

- Browse all player shops in one unified market UI.
- Search by **shop name**, **owner name**, **item name**, or **item ID**.
- Click an item card to see details, set the number of bundles to buy, and purchase.
- Players cannot buy from their own shop.

### Server Administration

- Configure minimum/maximum prices, max items per operation, max listings per shop, and max shop name length.
- Admin command to delete any player's shop directly.

## How to Use

Open the market:

```mcfunction
/vss_market open
```

Open a specific player's shop:

```mcfunction
/vss_market open
```

Delete a shop (requires permission level 4):

```mcfunction
/vss_market delete
```

server-market.title: Server Market
server-market.description: Currency and Market Mod for Minecraft Server
server-market.body:
**Server Market** is a Fabric server-side mod that brings a complete player-driven economy and marketplace to your server. Players can check their balance, send money to others (even offline players), and review their transaction history — all through simple commands or an intuitive GUI. The mod features both a player market and a system shop where items can be listed, bought, and sold with full NBT variant support. It also supports purchase orders with parcel station delivery, so buyers can place requests and sellers can fulfill them without needing to meet face-to-face. Administrators can optionally introduce physical currency items, set up system shop prices, manage player balances directly, and configure the economy to suit their needs. Storage defaults to SQLite for zero-setup operation, but can be switched to MySQL with optional [XConomy](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/xconomy.75669/) record mirroring for shared database environments. For server owners running 1.21.9 or newer, the mod bundles Placeholder API support out of the box. Developers can hook into the exposed API and event system to query balances, process transfers, intercept purchases, or integrate the economy into their own mods.

## Requirements

Required:
- **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)** (version matched to your MC version)
- **[Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)** **1.13.8+kotlin.2.3.0**
- **[Fabric Permissions API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-permissions-api)** **0.5.0**

Optional:
- **[LuckPerms](https://modrinth.com/mod/luckperms)** (recommended) for permission management
- **[Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api)** (1.21.9+ JAR only)

## Commands

Player:
```bash
/svm
/svm menu

/svm money
/svm balance
/svm pay <player> <amount>
/svm history [page]

/svm sell <price>
/svm restock <quantity>
/svm pull

/svm list
/svm search <keyword>

/svm buy <quantity> <item> [seller]

/svm cash <value> <quantity>
/svm exchange <amount>

/svm order <price> <amount>
/svm supply <quantity>
```

Admin:
```bash
/svm admin balance <player>
/svm admin set <player> <amount>
/svm admin add <player> <amount>
/svm admin remove <player> <amount>
/svm admin rank
/svm admin history <player> [page]

/svm admin price <price> [limit]
/svm admin pull
/svm admin purchase <price> [limit]

/svm admin cash <value>
/svm admin cash get
/svm admin cash del
/svm admin cash list [item]

/svm admin reload
```

## Updates

- Command wording updated:
  - purchase order: `/svm purchase` -> `/svm order`
  - sell to buyer: `/svm selltopurchase` -> `/svm supply`
- Removed command group: `/svm edit` (admin commands are now under `/svm admin`).
- Deprecated: `/svm admin lang`

## Placeholder API

Available in the **1.21.9+ JAR only** when Placeholder API is installed:

- `%server-market:balance%`
- `%server-market:balance_short%`
- `%server-market:parcel_count%`
- `%server-market:player_name%`
- `%server-market:top_name:<rank>%` (rank 1–10)
- `%server-market:top_balance:<rank>%` (rank 1–10)
- `%server-market:top_balance_short:<rank>%` (rank 1–10)

## Integration API

Entry point: `asagiribeta.serverMarket.api.ServerMarketApiProvider`

- `getBalance`, `hasEnough`, `getParcelCount`
- `addBalance`, `withdraw`, `setBalance`, `transfer`
- `getTopBalances`, `getHistory`, `format`, `openMenu`, `getModVersion`

EconomyProvider (Vault-style): `asagiribeta.serverMarket.api.economy.EconomyProviderRegistry`

- `withdraw`, `format`

Events:
- `ServerMarketEvents.BALANCE_CHANGED`
- `ServerMarketEvents.PRE_PURCHASE` (return false to cancel)
- `ServerMarketEvents.POST_PURCHASE`

## Configuration / Storage

Config file: `config/server-market/config.properties`

Reload in-game: `/svm admin reload`

### Economy

| Key | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `initial_player_balance` | `100.0` | Balance for first-time joiners |
| `max_transfer_amount` | `1000000.0` | Max amount per `/svm pay` |
| `enable_transaction_history` | `true` | Record transactions |
| `max_history_records` | `10000` | Auto-prune oldest records |
| `enable_tax` | `false` | Tax on player shop sales |
| `market_tax_rate` | `0.05` | Tax rate (0.0–1.0) |

### Storage (SQLite — default)

| Key | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `storage_type` | `sqlite` | `sqlite` or `mysql` |
| `sqlite_path` | `market.db` | Database file path |

### Storage (MySQL / [XConomy](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/xconomy.75669/))

Set `storage_type=mysql` and configure `mysql_host`, `mysql_port`, `mysql_database`, `mysql_user`, `mysql_password`, `mysql_use_ssl`, `mysql_jdbc_params`.

[XConomy](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/xconomy.75669/) table names (when sharing an existing database):

| Key | Default |
|-----|---------|
| `xconomy_player_table` | `xconomy` |
| `xconomy_non_player_table` | `xconomynon` |
| `xconomy_record_table` | `xconomyrecord` |
| `xconomy_login_table` | `xconomylogin` |
| `xconomy_system_account` | `SERVER` |
| `xconomy_write_record` | `false` |

Set `xconomy_write_record=true` to mirror transactions into [XConomy](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/xconomy.75669/)'s record table (MySQL only).

### Debug

| Key | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `enable_debug_logging` | `false` | Verbose debug logs |

Marketplace is a simple and vanilla friendly mod inspired by the Minecraft Bedrock Marketplace and the well known Essentials and Vault plugins. Unlike most other store-like modifications, this one requires you to collect and give the items (by right-clicking) to an unemployed villager to unlock trading these exact items. This mechanic makes it so you still need to explore Minecraft fully, as intended by the gameplay designers, while cutting off the physical grind required for those who prefer to just relax and build.

**NOTE:** This mod recently got revamped as a datapack and only a few items are currently supported for trading. This modification works in a manner that supports something recognized by this datapack as a module. A module is an individual tag-like compatibility datapack for supporting specific mods.

bartering.body:
![pd](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11359992e2490bbaacd366e94220e870af31b7e1.png)
- #### Supported versions: (1.21 - 26.2)


# About Me
**Better Markets** is a **Minecraft Survival Multiplayer Addon/Datapack** that **allows players** in **a server** to **sell their items in exchange for other items (bartering).**
It uses the **Minecraft Villager Trading UI** as **FOUNDATION** for the **Market Listing Display And Interaction.**

# Features
- ### Create Multiple Listings!
> Players can create AS MANY LISTINGS as they want! They can also ask for a combination of at-most TWO ITEMS 
> `(similar to how villagers can accept/ask for two items in exchange for a single item)`
- ### Infinite Market Length!
> A server can have a NEARLY INFINITE NUMBER of Market Listings available for player to navigate through! This allows room for multiple offers for the same item! There is no restriction to applicable offers!
- ### Item Bank!
> Players can also buy items from offline players! Every purchase made is transferred to a virtual storage that can only be withdrawn by their owners! It returns the items bartered/traded for in a bundle which disappears after their contents are withdrawn!

# How To ..
- ### create a Market Listing?
> Any and ALL players can create a Market Listing by running the command: `/trigger pm-createListing`. You will be sent a tellraw message instructing you on how to set-up your inventory, mainly your offhand and your hotbar's first two slots, Slot 0 and Slot 1.
> To create a listing, 
> - Put the item that you are willing to sell in your offhand.
> - Put the items you want in your First Slot and Second Slot.
> - Then, run the command `/trigger pm-createListing set 2` 
- ### withdraw/receive items from a Trade/Barter?
> All your trade items are stored in a "bank" type storage. To access the list of transactions you own, run the command `/trigger pm-itemBank`. Then, click on any of the given Bank Vault ID to receive your items in a bundle.

marketplaceplus.body:
# MarketPlacePlus

## 📋 Description

MarketPlacePlus brings a full-featured marketplace system to your server. Players can list items for sale, browse listings, create personal shops, and track their trading history. With an intuitive GUI system and robust economy integration, it's everything you need for a thriving player economy.

## ✨ Features

- **Global Marketplace** - List items for all players to browse and purchase
- **Player Shops** - Create personal shops with custom names and descriptions
- **Shop Ratings** - Rate shops 1-5 stars, view ratings before visiting
- **Shop Advertisements** - Promote your shop to all online players
- **Categories** - Auto-categorized items for easy browsing
- **Search System** - Find exactly what you're looking for
- **Trade History** - Track all your purchases and sales
- **Price Analytics** - View average prices and market trends
- **Expiring Listings** - Items return to sellers after expiration
- **MySQL/SQLite Support** - Choose your preferred database
- **Vault Integration** - Works with your existing economy

## 🎮 Commands
- /market - Opens the main marketplace GUI
- /market sell <price> - List item in hand for sale
- /market search <item> - Search for specific items
- /market history - View your trade history
- /market shop - Manage your player shops
- /market shop create <name> - Create a new shop
- /market shop delete - Delete your shop
- /market reload - Reload configuration (admin)

## 🔐 Permissions
- marketplace.use - Access the marketplace
- marketplace.sell - List items for sale
- marketplace.search - Use search feature
- marketplace.history - View trade history
- marketplace.shop.create - Create player shops
- marketplace.shop.delete - Delete shops
- marketplace.admin - Admin commands

## 🖼️ GUI Previews

## 🚀 Coming Soon

# 📈 Lifesteal Market

**The live stock market for lifesteal.net's auction house, right inside Minecraft.**

Price charts, live order books, price alerts, your true net worth and a wealth leaderboard. Press **M** and you're in.

![The /stock chart: AH price vs buy orders, the live order book and compare](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3mI2NuRG/images/0d4a72ac3a95ba174c798e29bd5688cda1aac759.png)

## Why you want it

- **Stop overpaying.** See the cheapest listing, the real price history and what buyers are paying before you spend a coin.
- **Sell for more.** See what everything you carry is worth and which place pays the most for it.
- **Never miss a deal.** Set a price and get pinged in game, or in your Discord DMs, the moment it hits.
- **Know where you stand.** Your net worth, tracked over time and ranked against everyone else who runs the mod.

## What's inside

Everything lives in one window with eleven tabs along the top:

**Today · Stock · Market · Buy · Sell · Calc · History · Worth · Board · Shop · Style**

Click a tab or flip through them with the arrow keys.

### Stock: live price charts

- A chart for any auction-house item: 1d, 3d, 7d or 30d. Scroll to zoom, hover for the exact price and time.
- **Buy-order line:** what buyers are offering on /orders, drawn against the AH price, with the gap between the two.
- **Order book:** every live listing, cheapest first, with the seller's name.
- **Compare:** add more items to the same chart.
- Favourites ★ and a one-click **View on AH** button.

### 🔔 Price alerts

- Click the bell on any item and choose **drops below** or **rises above**.
- You get an in-game pop-up and a sound the moment it hits.
- Link Discord and you also get a **DM, even while you're offline**. Run `/link` in our Discord, then `/lsmlink <code>` in game.

### Today, Market, Buy, Sell, Calc and History

- **Today:** the biggest gainers, biggest drops and most traded items of the last 24 hours.
- **Market:** the server's /market season goods, each with its own price chart.
- **Buy** (`/buynow`): where an item is cheapest right now, AH or /market. Click to go there.
- **Sell** (`/sellnow`): everything you're holding, the best place to sell each item and what it pays.
- **Calc:** add items and amounts and see what the whole lot would cost at the cheapest AH listings right now.
- **History:** recent sales of any item, its median price and how long it usually sits on the AH.

![Sell It Now: everything you hold, where it sells best and what it pays](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3mI2NuRG/images/810bf0dca392f9332ec61b72f55518475603326c.png)

### 💰 Net worth, leaderboard and teams

- **Worth** (`N` or `/networth`): your coins, inventory, ender chest, shulker contents and active AH listings, valued at live prices, with a value-over-time graph.
- **Board:** the richest players who run the mod. Search anyone and click a name to see their wealth graph.
- **Team board:** teams ranked by their combined net worth, spawners included.
- Net worth shows next to names in chat and on nametags for everyone running the mod. Rather keep yours quiet? Set it to **Private** and it's hidden everywhere.
- Opt in to **share your ender chest** and other players can look inside from your leaderboard card.
- `/networth <player>` looks up anyone whose net worth is public.

![A player's leaderboard card with their wealth graph](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3mI2NuRG/images/1b15feaf57be5599554a9d545d43f5bad1fb7277.png)

### Hover prices

- Hover any item to see **last sold, 24h average, cheapest now** and what the whole stack is worth.
- **Shulker boxes** show the value of the box plus everything inside it.
- Your total inventory value sits in the corner while your inventory is open.

![Hovering a shulker box shows what it and its contents are worth](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3mI2NuRG/images/5393ab31302bfb36788be42747c2e88f5af0323c.png)

### 🎨 Shop and Style

- **Shop (coming soon):** cosmetic GUI themes, name colours, gradient names, tags and backgrounds. Join the Discord to hear when it opens.
- **Style** (`/customize`): your wardrobe for GUI colour, name colour, gradient, tag and title. GUI colours are free to switch. Name flair is seen by everyone who runs the mod.
- Open the market on 5 different days to earn a **free name colour**.
- Cosmetics are looks only. They never give a gameplay or market advantage.

![The Style wardrobe: free GUI colours and a preview of your nametag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/3mI2NuRG/images/f54399afc97bb85761c23b3f4f6a53eec06b203c.png)

### Settings

- **Seller / Buyer mode** decides whether a rising price shows green or red.
- Graph line colour, GUI size (Small, Normal, Large) and a 12 or 24-hour clock.
- Hover prices, the inventory Market button and Discord DMs are each one toggle.
- Privacy: net worth Public or Private, ender chest Private or Shared, auto commands on or off, team board on or off.

### And also

- **Invite friends:** run `/referral` to get your invite line. Each new player who runs `/referral <your name>` and links Discord moves you up the tiered nametag tags.
- **Partners:** one click to the Discords we work with.
- **Update check:** when a new version is out you get a chat message and a button in /stock that opens the download.
- A short guided tour the first time you open /stock on lifesteal.net. Skip it any time.

## Coming soon: the Advisor

A paid tab that will point out items trading below their usual price and help you time selling what you own. It only makes suggestions: it never trades for you and it can't promise a profit. Join the Discord to hear when it lands.

## Which file do I download?

Pick the file for your Minecraft version. Every version needs **Fabric Loader** and **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**. The mod is client-side only.

| Minecraft | File |
|---|---|
| 1.21.11 | `lifestealmarket-1.2.1_1.21.11.jar` |
| 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | `lifestealmarket-1.2.1_26.1.jar` |
| 26.2 | `lifestealmarket-1.2.1_26.2.jar` |
| 26.3 | `lifestealmarket-1.2.1_26.3.jar` |

The Modrinth App and most launchers pick the right one for you. Updating? Delete the old Lifesteal Market jar from your `mods` folder first.

## Commands and keys

| Key or command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `M` or `/stock [item]` | Open the market, or jump straight to an item |
| `N` or `/networth [player]` | Your net worth, or look up another player |
| `/buynow [item]` | Where an item is cheapest right now |
| `/sellnow` | The best place to sell what you're holding |
| `/lsmarket` | The /market season goods |
| `/customize` | Your cosmetics wardrobe |
| `/lsmshop` | The cosmetics shop (coming soon) |
| `/lsmlink <code>` | Link Discord for DM price alerts |
| `/referral <name>` | Say who invited you (`/referral` on its own shows your invites) |

Change the keys any time in Options > Controls > Key Binds.

## FAQ

**Is it allowed on lifesteal.net?**

Yes. Lifesteal Market was approved by the server's developers. It's a viewer: it reads prices and your own account info, and it never buys, sells, lists or plays for you.

**Does it buy or sell things for me?**

No. It never buys, sells or lists anything. Buy and Sell only take you to the right menu (the AH search, /market or the item's /orders page). The final click is always yours.

**What data does it send?**

- Market observations (item names, prices and sale times), pooled so everyone gets better charts.
- Your username and net worth total, plus its history. Set net worth to **Private** and nobody else can see it.
- Your ender chest contents, but only if you switch on **Shared** yourself. Switching it off deletes the shared copy.
- Your team from /team info, while the team board setting is on.
- If you link Discord, which Discord account goes with your username. That link is never shown publicly.
- Like any connection, the market server sees your IP. It is hashed the moment it arrives, only used to stop abuse, and never stored or shared.
- It never reads your files and never sees your password. Your account is verified through Mojang, the same way a server does it.

The full details are on the Terms screen you see the first time you join.

**What are "auto commands"?**

To keep your net worth accurate the mod runs normal commands for you, quietly and spaced out: `/ah history`, `/ah claims`, `/bal`, `/ec` and `/team info`. They only run if you click **I Agree** on the Terms screen. Switch **Auto commands** off in Settings and it only ever runs what you type.

**Which jar do I need?**

The one for your Minecraft version, see the table above. A jar only loads on the game version it was built for.

**Does it work on other servers?**

It's made for lifesteal.net only. The prices all come from lifesteal.net's auction house, and net worth, hover prices and the inventory button only switch on while you're playing there.

**Does it work with Lunar Client?**

Yes, on versions where Lunar Client supports Fabric mods.

## Support and links

- **Discord:** help, bug reports and update news: [discord.gg/ta6Q2DV2Z3](https://discord.gg/ta6Q2DV2Z3)
- **Patreon:** keeps the market server running: [patreon.com/cw/LifestealMarket](https://www.patreon.com/cw/LifestealMarket)
- **Source code:** [github.com/tomdamjan1-collab/Lifesteal-Market](https://github.com/tomdamjan1-collab/Lifesteal-Market)

blockstreet.title: BlockStreet - Virtual Stock Market
blockstreet.description: Trade fake stocks and win, or lose in-game money.
blockstreet.body:
![BlockStreet Banner](https://i.imgur.com/t6YRvUQ.png)

### BlockStreet: The Ultimate Stock Market Simulation for Minecraft

Bring the excitement of real-world trading to your Minecraft server with BlockStreet, the plugin that transforms gameplay into an immersive economic experience.

**Buy. Sell. Profit.**

Allow players to invest in virtual companies, watch the stocks rise and fall, and make strategic decisions to grow their in-game wealth. Will they play it safe or take a risk for higher rewards?

**Risk & Reward**

Every company comes with a risk level—high-risk stocks swing big, while low-risk options offer steady but smaller returns. Choose a strategy and dominate the market.

**Custom Companies**

Allow players to start their own companies, set stock prices, and convince other players to invest in their companies.

![BlockStreet Showcase](https://i.imgur.com/HLlJtey.png)

![BlockStreet Commands](https://i.imgur.com/1KrhTou.png)

You can check all the available commands in-game using /invest help

![BlockStreet Permissions](https://i.imgur.com/VOxEAvR.png)

- **blockstreet.command.main** - give the player access to command _/invest_.
- **blockstreet.command.help** - give the player access to command _/invest help_.
- **blockstreet.command.portfolio** - give the player access to command _/invest portfolio_.
- **blockstreet.command.buy** - give the player access to command _/invest buy_.
- **blockstreet.command.sell** - give the player access to command _/invest sell_.
- **blockstreet.command.companies** - give the player access to command _/invest companies_.
- **blockstreet.command.company** - give the player access to command _/invest company_.
- **blockstreet.command.reload** - give the player access to command _/invest reload_.
- **blockstreet.command.create** - allows players to create their own companies using the command _/invest company create_.
- **blockstreet.command.delete** - allows players to delete companies they fully control using the command */invest company delete*.
- **blockstreet.admin.command.create** - allows administrators to create server companies using */invest admin create* command
- **blockstreet.admin.command.delete** - allows administrators to delete server companies using */invest admin delete* command 
- **blockstreet.ui.companies** - grant permission to open the Companies GUI.
- **blockstreet.ui.portfolio** - grants permission to open the Portfolio GUI.
- **blockstreet.ui.notifications** - grants permission to open the Notifications GUI.


![BlockStreet Configuration](https://i.imgur.com/TnrxNKA.png)

BlockStreet is fully configurable. You can create new companies, change each company's predefined stock value, change its risk, and change the number of stocks that each company has to sell.

Config.yml:


```yaml
BlockStreet:
  Version: 2.0.0                # Do not change this, it is used for internal purposes
  InterestInterval: 10
  Updates:
    Remainder: true
  StockCrash:
    Enabled: true              # Enable or disable stock crashes.
    Aggressiveness: 0.7        # Value between 0 and 1. A higher value means more frequent crashes.
  Taxes:
    CompanyCreation:           # Tax applied when creating company, applied over the valuation, per risk level
      - 0.1                    # Risk 1 (10% of the total valuation)
      - 0.2                    # Risk 2 (20% of the total valuation)
      - 0.3                    # Risk 3 (30% of the total valuation)
      - 0.4                    # Risk 4 (40% of the total valuation)
      - 0.5                    # Risk 5 (50% of the total valuation)
  Limits:
    MinBalance: 0.1            # Minimum balance a player must have after buying stocks as % of total investment value (defaults to 10 %)
    MaxSharesPerPlayer: 1000   # Maximum number of shares a player can own (set -1 to disable)
```

**Important:** There are some translations created by the community available for Czech and Japanese. You can access them [here](https://github.com/Hugo1307/BlockStreet/tree/main/lang). Beware that these translations may be incomplete!

![BlockStreet Signs](https://i.imgur.com/7JOwWw9.png)

You can add signs to show information about the company's current stock value.

**Create a sign**
To create a company sign, you should do the following:

- 1st line: [BlockStreet]
- 2nd line: Name of the company

And it's done! The sign should show information about the stocks of the selected company.

![BlockStreet Dependencies](https://i.imgur.com/upzCMvc.png)

BlockStreet depends on **Vault** to provide economy features. Make sure you have it installed in your server before using BlockStreet!

![BlockStreet Support](https://i.imgur.com/0xmfUMs.png)

Please feel free to propose new functionalities and report any kind of bug. To report bugs and/or get support please join our Discord server.

If you have any questions regarding the plugin or need support installing/configuring it, you can also join the Discord server and ask your questions there!

[https://discord.gg/ezxQGPpGGN](https://discord.gg/ezxQGPpGGN)

schematic-market.title: Schematic Market
schematic-market.description: A marketplace mod where players can buy and place pre-made constructions using an in-game economy system.
schematic-market.body:
# Schematic Market

Transform your Minecraft server with an integrated construction marketplace! Players can browse, purchase, and instantly place beautiful pre-made structures.

## ✨ Features

- **📚 Construction Catalog**: Browse available constructions with thumbnails and details
- **💎 Economy Integration**: Purchase constructions using emeralds (customizable currency)
- **🔄 Rotation Support**: Place structures in any of 4 directions (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°)
- **🏗️ Instant Placement**: Right-click to place your purchased construction
- **📦 Multiple Formats**: Supports both .schem and .schematic files
- **⚙️ Server-Friendly**: Add custom constructions without updating the mod

## 🎮 How to Use

1. Press **C** to open the Construction Catalog
2. Browse available constructions
3. Click on a construction to view details
4. Select rotation and click **BUY**
5. Right-click on a block to place the construction

## 🎯 Economy Commands
```
/balance - Check your balance
/balance add <player> <amount> - Add currency
/balance remove <player> <amount> - Remove currency
/balance set <player> <amount> - Set balance
```

## 📋 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric API
- Fabric Loader

## 🐛 Known Issues

- Some complex block states might not preserve perfectly
- Large constructions (1000+ blocks) may cause brief lag on placement

## 📝 License

MIT License - Feel free to use in your modpacks!

## 💬 Support

Found a bug? Have a suggestion? Open an issue on GitHub!

miners-market.title: Miner's Market
miners-market.description: Compete to strike it rich — mine ores, sell to the merchant, and be the first to earn 10,000 gold! The first player to reach the goal wins!
miners-market.body:
## ⛏️ Miner's Market - Competitive Mining Challenge

**A competitive mining mod for Minecraft**

Compete to strike it rich — mine ores, sell to the merchant, and be the first to earn 10,000 gold! The first player to reach the goal wins!

---

## ✨ Features

### 🏪 Market at Spawn
- **Auto-Generated Market**: A market structure spawns automatically at the world spawn point
- **NPC Merchant**: A merchant NPC stands ready to buy your ores and ingots
- **Starter Equipment**: Each player receives a powerful Miner's Pickaxe and supplies from a chest

### ⛏️ Miner's Pickaxe
- **Fortune III**: Built-in Fortune III enchantment for maximum ore drops
- **High Durability**: 4096 durability — lasts through long mining sessions
- **Fast Mining**: Mining speed of 12.0 — faster than diamond tools

### 💰 Ore Trading
Sell your mined items to the merchant for gold:

| Item | Price | Item | Price |
|------|-------|------|-------|
| Coal | 1 | Raw Copper | 1 |
| Copper Ingot | 2 | Lapis Lazuli | 3 |
| Raw Iron | 5 | Iron Ingot | 10 |
| Raw Gold | 7 | Gold Ingot | 15 |
| Redstone | 5 | Diamond | 30 |
| Emerald | 10 | Amethyst Shard | 10 |
| Netherite Ingot | 100 | | |

### 📈 Price Events
- **Dynamic Pricing**: Every 10 minutes, a random price event occurs — ore prices go up or down!
- **Timed Events**: Each event lasts 3–5 minutes, keeping the game exciting
- **HUD Indicator**: Active price events are shown on your HUD with the current multiplier
- **Title Announcements**: Price changes are announced with on-screen titles so you never miss them
- **Strategy Element**: Decide whether to sell now or wait for better prices

### 📊 Real-Time HUD
- **Earnings Display**: Track your current gold with a coin icon
- **Play Time**: See your elapsed time in MM:SS format
- **Rankings**: View finished players and their times
- **Floating Notifications**: Sale amounts pop up when you sell items
- **Market Direction Marker**: Always know which way to the market
- **Price Event Status**: See when a price event is active and the current price multiplier

### 🎮 Game Flow
- **Game Start Block**: Press to begin a 5-second countdown, then the race starts
- **Game Reset Block**: Double-click within 5 seconds to reset the game
- **Night Vision**: All players receive permanent night vision for mining
- **Victory Notifications**: Announcements when players reach the goal

---

## 📖 How to Play

1. **Create a New World**: Start a new world with the mod installed
2. **Find the Market**: A market structure is generated at the spawn point
3. **Grab Your Gear**: Take a Miner's Pickaxe and bread from the chest
4. **Start the Game**: Press the Game Start block to begin the countdown
5. **Mine Ores**: Head underground and mine as many ores as you can
6. **Sell to Merchant**: Return to the market and right-click the merchant while holding items
7. **Reach 10,000 Gold**: The first player to earn 10,000 gold wins!

---

## 🛠️ Technical Details

### Multi-Loader Support
This mod is built with **Architectury** and supports **multiple mod loaders**!
- **1.21.1–1.21.9**: Fabric and NeoForge
- **1.20.1**: Fabric and Forge
- Download the correct version for your mod loader
- Shared codebase ensures consistent experience across loaders

### Requirements

#### Minecraft 1.21.9
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.18.4+ with Fabric API 0.134.1+1.21.9, OR NeoForge 21.9.16-beta+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 18.0.3+

#### Minecraft 1.21.8
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.18.4+ with Fabric API 0.136.0+1.21.8, OR NeoForge 21.8.52+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 17.0.8+

#### Minecraft 1.21.7
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.18.4+ with Fabric API 0.129.0+1.21.7, OR NeoForge 21.7.25-beta+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 17.0.8+

#### Minecraft 1.21.6
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.18.4+ with Fabric API 0.128.2+1.21.6, OR NeoForge 21.6.20-beta+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 17.0.6+

#### Minecraft 1.21.5
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.18.4+ with Fabric API 0.126.0+1.21.5, OR NeoForge 21.5.96+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 16.1.4+

#### Minecraft 1.21.4
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.18.4+ with Fabric API 0.119.3+1.21.4, OR NeoForge 21.4.156+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 15.0.3+

#### Minecraft 1.21.3
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.16.10+ with Fabric API 0.107.3+1.21.3, OR NeoForge 21.3.95+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 14.0.4+

#### Minecraft 1.21.1
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.17.3+ with Fabric API 0.116.7+1.21.1, OR NeoForge 21.1.209+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 13.0.8+

#### Minecraft 1.20.1
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric Loader 0.16.10+ with Fabric API 0.92.2+1.20.1, OR Forge 47.3.0+
- **Dependencies**: Architectury API 9.2.14+

### Compatibility
- Works alongside other mods
- Compatible with performance mods (Sodium, Starlight, etc.)
- Designed for multiplayer but also works in singleplayer

---

## 🐛 Bug Reports & Suggestions

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Report it on our [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ksoichiro/MinersMarket/issues) page!

---

dkmarket.title: DK MARKET
dkmarket.description: DKMARKET is a Spigot 1.21 plugin that allows players to create their own individual shops with a graphical interface to sell items to other players in a marketplace system.
dkmarket.body:
## 📋 Overview
**DKMARKET** is an individual player marketplace system with graphical interface (GUI) developed for Spigot 1.21. It allows each player to have their own virtual shop where they can sell items to other players.

## 🎯 Main Features
- **Individual shops** for each player
- **Intuitive graphical interface** (GUI) for management
- **Economy system** compatible with Vault and PlayerPoints
- **Global marketplace** to view all shops
- **Centralized administration** with control panel

## 🎮 Commands

### Main Command: `/dkmarket` or `/market` or `/shop`
- **Description**: Main marketplace command
- **Usage**: `/dkmarket [item]`
- **Aliases**: `market`, `shop`

#### Sub-commands:
- `/dkmarket` - Opens the main marketplace interface
- `/dkmarket item` - Adds the held item to your shop (requires holding an item)

## 🔐 Permissions

### Plugin Permissions:
- `dkmarket.use` - Permission to use the marketplace *(default: true)*
- `dkmarket.create` - Permission to create shops *(default: true)*
- `dkmarket.admin` - Full permission to manage all shops and settings *(default: op)*

### How it works:
- **Players with `dkmarket.create`** can automatically create their own shops
- **Players with `dkmarket.use`** can browse the marketplace and buy items
- **Administrators with `dkmarket.admin`** have access to the admin panel

## 🛒 Shop Features

### For shop owners:
- Automatically create shop when using the command
- Add items by holding them and using `/dkmarket item`
- Set custom prices via chat
- Manage items through graphical interface
- Limit of 50 items per shop (configurable)

### For buyers:
- Browse global marketplace with all shops
- Buy items directly from other shops
- View prices in different currencies
- Intuitive interface with categories

## 💰 Economy System
- **Vault Support**: Compatible with all economy plugins that use Vault
- **PlayerPoints Support**: Alternative using player points
- **Configurable prices**: Minimum 1 coin, maximum 1,000,000 (configurable)
- **Multiple currencies**: Support for different currency types

## ⚙️ Configuration
The plugin has a `config.yml` file with options for:
- Default currency type
- Item limits per shop
- Automatic save interval
- Customization of messages and interfaces
- Security and permission settings

## 🔧 Dependencies
- **Soft-depend**: Vault and PlayerPoints (optional, but recommended)
- **Server version**: Spigot 1.21 or higher

## 📊 Data Saving
- Data automatically saved every 5 minutes (configurable)
- Data persistence between server restarts
- Automatic backup when disabling the plugin

dynamic-market.title: Dynamic Market
dynamic-market.description: A Minecraft plugin that adds a Dynamic Market
dynamic-market.body:
# DynamicMarket 

 A Minecraft economy plugin that introduces an interactive marketplace with dynamic prices that automatically adjust based on supply and demand. 
 
  ✨ Features 
  📈 Dynamic pricing that adapts to trading activity 
 🗂️ Category-based organization with customizable GUI slots 
  🖥️ Intuitive GUIs for buying and selling 
 🔧 Full admin controls for market management 
 💰 Vault economy integration 
  
 📦 Dependencies 

  Vault (required) 
 Compatible with any Vault-supported economy plugin 
 Works with Minecraft 1.13+ 
 
 🕹️ Commands 

### Player Commands 
 /market → Opens the market GUI to buy items 
 
 /sell → Opens the market GUI to sell items 
### Admin Commands 
    /marketadmin addcategory <name> <icon> → Create a new category 
    /marketadmin add <category> <price> → Add the item in hand to the market 
    /marketadmin remove <category> <item> → Remove an item from the market 
    /marketadmin setprice <category> <item> <buy_price> [sell_price] → Set custom prices 
    /marketadmin move <from> <to> <item> → Move items between categories 
    /marketadmin reset → Reset the market to default 
    /marketadmin stock <category> <item> <amount> → Set item stock 
    /marketadmin addstock <category> <item> <amount> → Increase item stock 
    /marketadmin removestock <category> <item> <amount> → Decrease item stock 
    /marketsettings <setting> <value> → Change market settings in-game 
    /setslot <category> <slot> → Set GUI slot position for a category 
    /marketadmin setslot <category> <item> <slot> → Set GUI slot position for an item in a category
    
 🔑 Permissions 

    market.admin.category → Create & manage categories 
    market.admin.add → Add new items 
    market.admin.remove → Remove items from categories 
    market.admin.setprice → Change item prices 
    market.admin.move → Move items between categories 
    market.admin.reset → Reset the market 
    market.admin.stock → Set item stock 
    market.admin.addstock → Increase item stock 
    market.admin.removestock → Decrease item stock 
    market.admin.slot → Change GUI category positions 
    market.admin → Grants all admin permissions 
 
📊 Pricing System

 Prices auto-adjust based on trade volume 
 Buy prices increase when items are bought frequently 
 Sell prices decrease when items are sold frequently 
 Adjustment rate: 0.5% per traded item 
 Prices are capped between 0.1 and 1000.0 (by default, you can change it in the config.yml)

tradehub-markets.title: TradeHub Markets
tradehub-markets.description: A fully simulated investment system for Minecraft servers, allowing players to trade stocks, crypto and commodities in a realistic and configurable economy.
tradehub-markets.body:
# TradeHub Market — Simulated Stock Market System for Your Server

**Transform your server into a self-contained economy.** TradeHub Market brings
a fully simulated stock market system to your Paper server—featuring
stocks, crypto, commodities, realistic bid-ask spreads, and
trading fees. Everything runs entirely locally: **no connection to
real financial markets, no external APIs, and no ongoing costs.**

---

## ✨ Features

**4 Asset Categories**
Stocks, crypto, commodities, and rare commodities—each category has
its own configuration file and menu icon. Comes pre-filled with
example assets (Diamond Industries, BitRock, Iron, Gold,
and more), but is fully customizable.

**Realistic Trading**
No more trading exactly at the market price: players buy at the ask price and
sell at the bid price. The bid-ask spread and optional broker fees are
fully configurable (percentage-based or fixed amounts) and can be
disabled entirely if simpler trading is preferred.

**Automated Price Simulation**
Prices for each stock move automatically and randomly within a
set volatility range—including minimum and maximum price limits.
Each asset also displays a risk level (Low/Medium/High) so
players can make informed investment decisions.

**Intuitive GUI**
A single menu for everything: category selection, risk explanations,
and account balance & portfolio value at a glance. Buy with left-click,
sell with right-click, or buy/sell in batches of 10 by holding Shift.

**Full In-Game Asset Management**
No need to edit YAML files: a dedicated management interface
displays all assets, complete with search and category filters. The editor displays all fields at a glance as clickable items; simply click a field and enter a new value in the chat, and the editor automatically reopens with the updated value. Changes are only applied when clicking "Save." Admins can create, edit, duplicate, (de)activate, or delete assets (with a confirmation prompt)—including an automatic backup before every change.

**Vault Integration**
Works with any Vault-compatible economy plugin. It automatically detects multiple registered economy providers and always integrates the best available one, regardless of plugin load order.

**Persistent Data**
Portfolios and current prices are stored in a local SQLite database—asynchronously, without impacting the server tick. Restarts or updates do not reset prices.

**Optional Discord Integration**
Market news can be sent directly to your Discord server—no bot required, just a webhook. Fully controllable via a dedicated admin GUI (on/off, URL configuration, testing, status display); disabled by default. Servers without a Discord connection remain completely unaffected. Nine message types (market events, new/activated/deactivated assets, price records, high volatility) can be toggled individually; embed colors, title prefixes, and footer text are fully customizable—including a local preview and send log right in the admin GUI. Additionally, it offers automatic summary market reports (every 30 minutes, hourly, every 6 hours, or daily) featuring top gainers/losers, a category overview, market sentiment, and key events since the last report. **Dynamic Market News**
The market writes its own story: simulated economic events (e.g., "📈 Crypto on the rise!") appear regularly in the chat, noticeably shifting the price of a specific category. Market trends and volatility evolve organically based on recent events, with built-in safeguards against crashes or 100% spikes. Admins manage event types, categories, frequency, and custom headlines entirely via a dedicated GUI.

**Portfolio Performance**
Profit/loss at a glance: The account display shows the percentage change in value over 1 hour, 12 hours, one day, one week, and since the start—green for gains, red for losses. This runs fully automatically in the background.

**Portfolio Statistics**
Total profit, daily profit, average purchase price per position, and the best/worst currently held investment—all tracked automatically with every buy/sell transaction. Existing holdings from before the update are transparently marked as "Unknown" rather than displaying incorrect figures.

**Asset Statistics**
All-time high/low, moving average price, creation date, trading volume, and the largest price change ever recorded—accessible for any asset via `/stocks info <Symbol>`.

**Optional Trading Hours**
Each category can be restricted to a specific time window (e.g., stocks only from 08:00 to 20:00, while crypto remains open around the clock) or left open 24/7 by default. Settings are fully configurable via a dedicated admin GUI, including time windows that span across midnight.

**Multilingual (German & English)**
All chat messages are fully translated.

tradecraft-player-market-server-economy.title: TradeCraft - Player Market & Server Economy
tradecraft-player-market-server-economy.description: Simple player economy with Micro currency and markets
tradecraft-player-market-server-economy.body:
# TradeCraft - Player Market & Server Economy 💰

If you're looking for a **simple, lightweight, and practical economy system** for your Minecraft server, **TradeCraft** is built exactly for that.

TradeCraft introduces a small but powerful currency called **Micro**, designed to make trading between players smooth and natural without relying on complicated commands or oversized economy plugins.

When a player joins the server for the first time, they automatically receive **500 Micro** as a starting balance. This currency becomes the core of the server’s economy and can be used for trading, payments, and player-run markets.

One of the best parts is that **your money never disappears when you die**. No matter what happens in the world, your Micro balance stays safe. The goal of this mod is to encourage trading and player interaction, not punish mistakes.

---

## 💳 Simple Currency System

Your **Micro balance is always visible on the HUD**, displayed clearly near the hotbar so you can easily keep track of your money while playing.

No constant commands.
No menus to dig through.

Just a clean and simple display that keeps the economy part of the game without getting in the way.

---

## 🤝 Player-to-Player Trading

Trading with other players is quick and straightforward.

Simply **look at another player and press the "I" key**, and they will receive a trade request directly in chat.

They can choose:

✔ Accept
✖ Decline

If they accept, a small trading interface opens where players can **transfer Micro between each other**.

There are no item trades in this system — it's purely a **currency transfer** to keep everything clear and prevent trade scams.

Fast, simple, and perfect for quick payments.

---

## 📦 Market Chest – Player Shops

The biggest feature of TradeCraft is the **Market Chest**.

This special chest-like block allows players to create their own **automatic shops** directly in the world.

Players can configure the chest to **sell items** to others or **buy items** from other players.

---

### 🛒 Sell Mode

In Sell Mode, you place items in the Market Chest and set a price.

Example:

5 Diamonds
Price: 100 Micro

When another player purchases the item:

• The item is removed from the chest
• The buyer receives the item
• The seller receives the Micro payment

Even if the seller is **offline**, the money will still be delivered automatically.

This allows players to run shops that work **24/7**.

---

### 📥 Buy Orders

Players can also create **buy requests**.

Example:

Buying: 10 Iron
Reward: 50 Micro

If another player sells the requested item:

• The item is removed from the seller's inventory
• The seller receives the Micro payment
• The shop owner receives the item

For safety and inventory handling, the **shop owner must be online** to receive items from buy orders.

---

## 🔒 Shop Protection

Every Market Chest belongs to its owner.

Other players cannot:

* Change its settings
* Steal items from it
* Break it

Your shop stays completely secure.

---

## ⚡ Lightweight & Server Friendly

TradeCraft was designed with performance in mind.

It avoids complex systems and focuses only on the features that matter most for multiplayer servers:

• Player currency
• Safe trading
• Player-run shops

No unnecessary mechanics.
No heavy systems.

Just a clean and efficient economy system that fits naturally into Minecraft gameplay.

---

## 🌍 Perfect For Multiplayer Servers

TradeCraft is ideal for servers that want:

• A simple economy
• Player markets
• Easy money transfers
• A natural trading experience

Whether you're running a **small survival server with friends** or building a larger community, TradeCraft gives players the tools they need to create their own economy.

And the best part?

It all stays **simple, lightweight, and fun**.

haunted-harvest.title: Haunted Harvest
haunted-harvest.description: Pumpkin Carving, Corn food and Halloween Trick or Treating for villagers. Farmers Delight and Autumnity compatibility. Not just a seasonal mod
haunted-harvest.body:
Haunted Harvest


📖About📖



Haunted Harvest is a season themed mod which aims to add seasonality to your world in a vanilla way.

• Intricate seasonal AI for villagers and baby villagers, allowing for trick or treating
• Pumpkin carving
• Corn

 
You can use this in your modpacks

🍬Trick or Treating🍬

 

• Baby villagers will now wear a mask at night. They can have 8 possible masks: creeper, pumpkin, zombie, illager, piglin, skeleton, enderman, spider and paper bag.

 

• Baby villagers will go door to door once night sets and will start trick or treating. Once a villager interacts with an adult one of 3 things can happen:

 

1. The adult will give the kid a random Candy (which also includes some from other mods like Supplementaries) and the kid will then visit another villager.
2. The adult might not have any Candy and give the kid some Coal.
3. The kid's spooky costume might scare off the adult.
4. If a kid doesn't receive any Candy from an adult for whatever reason, he will take out some Eggs... You know what's next…

 

🧹Witch Interactions🧹

 

• If a baby villager is unfortunate enough to encounter a Witch during its night walk he will try to interact with her and ask her for Candy. Here 3 things can happen:

 

1. The Witch will spook and scare off the children.
2. The Witch will give the kid a Rotten Apple.
3. More rarely the Witch will give out a special Grim Apple to the unlucky trick or treater.



🌽Food🌽 

 

• During the day (and their play time so from 3000 ingame time) kids will actually start eating all the Candies that they have collected. Doing so will decrease their age a little and heal them. This means that they will be able to trick or treat for more nights in a row!

• Rotten Apples are a new food that has been added. It's similar to Rotten Flesh and can rarely drop from Oak and Dark Oak Leaves. It can be combined with many other nasty ingredients to make a Grim Apple.

• Grim Apples are a more evil version of Rotten Apples and can be seen as the opposite of a Golden Apple. They will give all sorts of negative effects when consumed. If a kid has a Grim Apple in its inventory he will consume as with any other food it receives but doing so will actually start converting it into a Witch so be careful!

• Corn is a new 3 blocks tall rare crop that can be rarely found in abandoned farms, a mysterious new structure that the mod adds. It can be crafted into various items like Popcorn, Candy Corn or put in a Paper Bag next to a Campfire to pop it! Also has full integration with Farmer’s Delight.

• Splattered Egg can be placed by throwing Eggs at any block.



🏘️Village Decorations🏘️

 

During Halloween season (from the 20th of October to 10th of November, adult villagers will begin placing 1 Pumpkin each around the village. Note that they cannot do so in their work time and in suitable location, that is on grass or sand and above y=64. Baby villagers can take out some Shears and carve any Pumpkin they see. This again happens during their play time so for example at time 3000. At night baby villagers will try to light up the last Pumpkin they carved. At the end of season (after the 10th of November or whatever is set in the configs) adult villagers will try to remove all the Pumpkins they have placed down. Also note that all of this is supposed to occur rarely so to gradually fill up a village.

 

🎃Pumpkin Carving🎃

 

• To carve a Pumpkin simply use a Shear on the top of a normal one. After this simply interact with it either through its GUI or using a Sword/Knife to carve it in world.
• Once you are happy with your design you can wax your Pumpkin to prevent further edit or craft it/click on it with a Torch to create a Jack'o'Lantern. Default carved Pumpkins can still be accessed by carving one on its side instead.
• Many recipes exist to duplicate existing designs from a Pumpkin to another.
• Just like any other Pumpkin you can wear it and give it to Snow Golems.
• The mod includes a data driven custom carving system which allows a set of pre defined patterns to spawn in abandoned house and placed by baby villagers.



🧩Integration and Extra🧩

 

• Baby villagers will no longer be targeted by hostile mobs. This means they'll be able to roam out at night without fear of getting killed.
• The mod is entirely customizable, with many options in the configs such as having it active year round or only during a certain period. By default it's trick or treating is always on and pumpkin placement only between October 1th and November 10th.
• The mod is meant to be included in every modpack since it can be set to seasonal mode and thus only be active during the selected period. Doing so will completely remove every feature of the mod from the ground up for maximum compatibility for the rest of the year, except for rotten apples and egg splattering.
• Farmer’s Delight integration which adds succotash, a new food made with corn. It also enables abandoned farms to sometime spawn with a tomato field.
• Serene Seasons compatibility allows the mod to only be enabled during certain seasons.
• Autumnity compatibility.
• Note that pumpkins placements is tied to MobGriefing. Given the fact that villagers can't breed either with griefing off (cause they can't pickup food), this means that if you have mob griefing off the mod will effectively be entirely disabled.

haunted-sounds.title: Haunted Sounds
haunted-sounds.description: A door creaks. A chest lid shifts. Somewhere close, always matching what's actually around you — nothing caused it.
haunted-sounds.body:
# Haunted Sounds

A door creaks somewhere close. A chest lid shifts. Wind moves through a
cave that has no wind. Nothing caused it.

## Features

Plays a single environmental sound — door, chest, barrel, trapdoor, gate,
lever, or a cave-ambience burst — from a random spot near you, at random
intervals.

Only plays sounds that actually make sense for where you are: door and
gate creaks only happen if a real one is actually nearby, chest and barrel
sounds only if one's actually there, cave ambience only when you're
genuinely underground with no sky above you. If nothing nearby fits, it
simply stays quiet rather than playing something that couldn't be real.

Broadcast to anyone nearby, not just you — a shared moment of "did you hear
that too?"

## Optional Features (Config Options)

- Whether the mod is enabled
- How often it can trigger (minimum/maximum interval)
- How far away it can occur (radius)
- Overall volume
- Each individual sound can be toggled on or off separately

haunted-chat.title: Haunted Chat
haunted-chat.description: Every so often, something addresses you directly in chat — short, personal, and a little too aware of what's actually happening around you.
haunted-chat.body:
# Haunted Chat

Every so often, something sends you a short message in chat. Not narration —
addressed straight at you.

## Features

Messages trigger at random intervals, delivered directly to chat like
someone (or something) is actually talking to you.

What gets said depends on what's actually happening around you. Standing
still too long, deep underground, playing late at night, alone on the
server, low on health, or just been at it a long while — each has its own
set of lines, picked based on your real situation the moment it triggers.
Falls back to a general pool when nothing specific applies.

## Optional Features (Config Options)

- Whether the mod is enabled
- How often messages can trigger (minimum/maximum interval)
- Broadcast to everyone online, or per-player individually
- Whether messages use your actual in-game name

haunted-note.title: Haunted Note
haunted-note.description: Every so often, a short, unsettling note flashes briefly over your hotbar — something noticing what's actually happening around you.
haunted-note.body:
# Haunted Note

Every so often, a short note flashes briefly over your hotbar. Not a chat
message — gone before you can be sure you read it right.

## Features

Delivered via the action bar, not chat — no history, no scrollback, just a
transient flash that lingers a little longer than usual before fading.

What appears depends on what's actually happening around you. Standing
still too long, deep underground, playing late at night, alone on the
server, low on health, or deep into a long session — each has its own set
of notes, picked based on your real situation the moment it triggers. Falls
back to a general pool when nothing specific applies.

Written as observations, not direct address — something noticing what's
happening, not talking to you.

## Optional Features (Config Options)

- Whether the mod is enabled
- How often it can trigger (minimum/maximum interval)
- How long each note stays visible
- Broadcast to everyone online, or per-player individually

haunted-encounters.title: Haunted Encounters v.1 [Fabric/NeoForge 1.21.1]
haunted-encounters.description: Spooky Ghosts from the Pokemon Tower invade your world, bringing a whole new otherwordly challenge!
haunted-encounters.body:
# Minecraft nights are always dangerous, with hostiles lurking everywhere.

**On a night of a full moon, you peek outside. Weird, the surrounding area seems to be devoid of any life, but you see something float in the distance. _It suddenly turns to stare at you with glowing eyes, sending shivers down your spine!_**




![Ghosts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aded41f4c7a85ea1b605464f265741af05ec9ac2.png)

Bringing spooky back, **Haunted Encounters** adds naturally spawning, new Ghost mobs inspired from the Pokemon Tower Ghosts from the Kanto Region. These lost souls serve as an alternative to vanilla hostile mobs, making your Cobblemon experience much more immersive **(and terrifying).**

![Ghosts roaming](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a249a0b92f34d8555d5aa4d502dfcbd74a07f02a_0.webp)

## **Ghosts come in different kinds, each scary in their own ways:**

**Forlorn Ghost** — charges in and hits hard.

**Spectral Ghost** — fires Shadow Balls.

**Flickering Ghost** — neutral… until provoked.

**Volatile Ghost** — closes in quietly and takes you down with it.

**Wailing Ghost** — merciless with its long-range rain of fire blasts.

**Pyrous Ghost** — shoots a relentless barrage of flames.

**Galeful Ghost** — launches powerful gales at you.

![Ghosts in the nether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef0d416911ee29da7f1c773ad614a58217d9c145_0.webp)


**_Passing through walls,_** Ghosts can be a menace to deal with. However, they are afraid of sunlight and will actively hide from the sun. They even have _**different personalities**_, some will fight back to the (second) death, some will flee when they feel like their end is near, and some will teleport and try to disorient you in combat. There are even rumors of villagers getting possessed, causing them to act strangely and turn hostile...


## Repel Ghosts from your base of safety with Cleanse Tags! Place a Cleanse Tag on a block and it will deter any lingering spirits from that point of placement.


![Cleanse tag on house](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b72432ae4e695438e24a1df8502eeb2e86ae5b4_0.webp)



## **Some say that Ghosts are just misunderstood wandering souls. Reveal their true forms by crafting and using a Silph Scope on them. You will be able to finally battle or catch the real face behind the specter!**



![Silph scope recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec295b086196ff5a9cd3e8dc6b9bb6092278c34a.png)


## **Pay your respects to the earthbound spirits, or put them to their final rest...**

Join my [Discord server](https://discord.gg/sjyv8HcdP2) for news, discussions, and support for Haunted Encounters and my other creations!

### **CREDITS**
All assets made by **Dogtor Bloo**. Huge thanks to **NecroSo1** for being the awesome developer of this mod, and to **Soul from Zinc Studios** for the SFX.

### **IMPORTANT**
- This mod requires Cobblemon and Geckolib as dependencies to run optimally.
- Pokemon that spawn from scoping a Ghost can be altered and adjusted through datapacks.

**ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.**

slender-the-haunted-forest.body:
## Watch the Trailer!
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/DZIMfC8fymQ" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

### REQUIRES GECKOLIB

**To play this you must select the slenderman gamemode from the gamerule menu before creating the world!**

This mod adds in the Slender the Eight Pages game into Minecraft. This is not your standard Minecraft mod. This mod adds in a Slender gamemode that is completely seperate from the standard Minecraft experience.

To play Slenderman in Minecraft you must create a new world and go into the gamerule options and turn on the slenderman gamemode option. Then you can simply create the world and the mod will do the rest!

You will be brought into the slenderman game. Your goal is to collect 8 pages. Right click on a page to collect it. Pages are located on the various structures that would be seen in the Slender game. Pages do not respawn so **creating a brand new world on death is recommended** (otherwise you will have to travel really far to find any pages).

Upon collecting the first page Slenderman will now be active. Do not look at Slenderman for too long or get too close, because otherwise you will meet your fate. Every time you collect a page, Slenderman will become more aggressive and harder to avoid.

Upon collecting the 8th page you will win the game and be transported into the vanilla Minecraft world, having escaped Slenderman's game.

Have fun and let me know if you find any bugs!

**NOTE: At this current point in time upon being transported back into the vanilla world, you will hear slenderman's sound being played every second for about 30 seconds until it stops. This may lead to your game crashing. If it does then just join back into the world and it should be fine. (This will try to be fixed)**
