hauntedsands-stationapi.title: HauntedSands StationAPI
hauntedsands-stationapi.description: A StationAPI mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 that adds new sand types, graves (death chests), and lost souls.
hauntedsands-stationapi.body:
# Haunted Sands

A StationAPI mod for Minecraft Beta 1.7.3 that adds new sand types, graves, and lost souls.
- Special thanks to DRAGON-STUDIO and HorrorSoundsAsWav over on Pixabay for the mob sounds!
- Credit to K1W1XD and Mimihanne for the skins used to make the lost soul entity.
- Mod works on Multiplayer with [GlassConfigAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-config-api) version 3.0+ used to sync configs!
  - Requires [ZastavkaAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/zastavkaapi) to work on servers, until StationAPI fixes its falling blocks.
- All features can be enabled/disabled through [GlassConfigAPI](https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-config-api) as well.

### Terrain Generation Features

* Allows overworld generation of rare pockets of gunpowder in caves
  * Generates between Y levels 4 and 52
  * Generates 0 to 23 gunpowder cubes
  * Does not generate in Forest, Plains, or Tundra biomes
  * Often will catch fire immediately from lava and explode on generation
    * Explosion is not strong enough to break stone
* Allows nether generation of stripes of redstone sand
  * Generates below Y level 80
  * Generates 0 to 63 redstone sand
* Allows nether generation of small flat stars of glowstone sand
  * Generates at all Y levels
  * Generates 0 to 13 glowstone sand

### Sand/Cube Features

* Glowstone Sand
  * Glows like glowstone and falls like sand!
  * When crafting is enabled glowstone sand is made like vanilla glowstone and glowstone is made by smelting the sand
  * Soil Properties:
    * Cactus and Sugar Cane can be planted and grow on it
    * Dead bushes can be planted on it (they will not grow)
* Redstone Sand
  * Emits a redstone signal when it lands
  * Soil Properties:
    * Dead bushes and small plants can be planted on it (they will not grow)
* Sugar Cube
  * Dissolves when it falls into water or lava
  * Saddled pigs can eat the sugar cube by walking on it
  * Soil Properties:
    * Sugar Cane can be planted and grow on it
    * Dead bushes and small plants can be planted on it (they will not grow)
* Gunpowder Cube
  * Explodes when it falls
  * Highly flammable
  * Soil Properties:
    * Cactus can be planted and grow on it
    * Dead bushes can be planted on it (they will not grow)

### Other Features

* Ability to create a lost soul on player death that is wearing the dead player's armor
  * Lost soul is a new flying mob that can no clip through blocks
  * The lost soul attacks by charging the player
    * Charge speed increases as the mob gets closer to their player target
    * Lost souls can charge a second time if they are in a solid opaque block
  * You can trap lost souls in translucent blocks like tree leaves, ice, glass, snow layers, tall grass, etc.
    * If you are having trouble with lost souls the surface is your friend!
  * Lost souls drop stolen armor on death along with a locked chest (used in the Grave crafting recipe)
  * No lost soul will be created if player inventory and armor slots are empty
  * Lost souls also spawn rarely when soul sand is broken
* Ability to create a grave on player death that contains main inventory items (including hotbar)
  * The grave will not contain armor or modded slot items
  * Grave vanishes on use and items are dropped (a permanent version can be crafted, see recipe below)
  * Grave is blast resistant to creepers
    * A creeper standing on it may still be able to blow it up (usually only happens with slab graves)
  * Grave will be a slab if less than half or half the main inventory slots are filled
    * Grave slabs combine using beta slab logic
  * Grave will be a full block (Columbarium) if more than half the main inventory slots are filled
  * No grave will be created if player main inventory is empty
* Pigs will now seek out sugar and brown mushrooms when they are in item form
  * Pigs will eat the sugar healing them 0.5 hearts if they are hurt
  * The pigs are rather finicky and sometimes won't seek out or do anything
    * You can try to push/prod them to get them moving again, but it won't always work
  * Saddled pigs also have a slight pathing preference for sugar cube and brown mushroom blocks (not noticeable in small quantities)
    * Saddled pigs lose their slight pathing preference for grass blocks since they are now seeking the other blocks

### Crafting Recipes

All crafting recipes can be turned on/off from the mod config menu.
* All sands/cubes are crafted by placing 4 of the correct item in a square.
  * If enabled sands/cubes can be de-crafted back into 4 of the item used to make them. (default disabled)
* Graves can be crafted with soul sand, any vanilla slab, and either a regular chest or a locked chest.
  * Locked chests are a vanilla block that is normally unobtainable but will drop when a lost soul mob is killed.

See: https://modrinth.com/project/hauntedsands-stationapi/gallery

## Installation using Prism Launcher

1. Download an instance of Babric for Prism Launcher: https://github.com/Glass-Series/babric-prism-instance
2. Install Java 17 and set the instance to use it: https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/
3. Add GlassConfigAPI 3.0.2+ to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-config-api
4. Add Glass Networking to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/glass-networking
5. Add StationAPI to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/stationapi
6. Add ZastavkaAPI to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/zastavkaapi
7. (Optional) Add Mod Menu to the mod folder for the instance: https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu-beta
8. Add this mod to the mod folder for the instance: https://github.com/telvarost/HauntedSands-StationAPI/releases
9. Run and enjoy! 👍

## Feedback

Got any suggestions on what should be added next? Feel free to share it by [creating an issue](https://github.com/telvarost/HauntedSands-StationAPI/issues/new). Know how to code and want to do it yourself? Then look below on how to get started.

## Contributing

Thanks for considering contributing! To get started fork this repository, make your changes, and create a PR. 

If you are new to StationAPI consider watching the following videos on Babric/StationAPI Minecraft modding: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9-sVGjnGJ5s&list=PLa2JWzyvH63wGcj5-i0P12VkJG7PDyo9T

sounds-of-the-forest.title: Sounds of the Forest
sounds-of-the-forest.description: Adds a new layer of horror without the use of entities.
sounds-of-the-forest.body:
You may or may not have seen those horror mods with all those dwellers and what not. They all of something in common. They all add a monster, at first they might be scary and what not, but after a while of seeing them over and over again they repetitive.

So to change things up I made this mod. It doesn’t any monsters or entities. Instead it adds various sounds that can be heard in a forest of any kind with the exception of the jungle. These sounds only play at night and if in a forest.

I made the mod this way to add a sense of being watched even when you know you are alone. This adds a layer of phycological horror that is meant to scare you when you are off-guard.

Of course it would get boring after a while of hearing the same sound over and over again, so I made it so that sounds are rarely heard.



Compatibility

SOTF works with any biome mod as long as the biome is tagged with minecraft:is_forest or minecraft:is_taiga.


Configuration

The mod comes with a configuration file that can be found in the config file in your minecraft directory. It is named SOTF.toml. Inside you can ajust the cooldown between each sound. If you change the cooldown and load into a pre-existing world, you will need to wait for the previews time to finish for it to reset to the time you set.

super-enchants.title: Super Enchants
super-enchants.description: Combine Vanilla Enchantment Books by Throwing them on top of Anvils.  Nearly All Vanilla Enchantments can Exceed their Level Caps.
super-enchants.body:
# Super Enchants

**Super Enchants** allows you to combine enchantments to much higher levels than you're able to do normally in survival mode.

# How to Combine Enchantments

Throwing 2 enchanted books on top of an anvil will combine them. If they have the same enchantment at the same level, the new enchanted book they create will have that enchantment at the next level. And if you throw an enchantment book and an enchantable item on top of an anvil, that enchantment will be applied to the item, removing the need for experience levels.

# Extra Item Compatibility (MC 1.20.5 and Newer)

If you want more items to work with Super Enchants. you can [click here](https://www.mediafire.com/file/bp3fp5cnaz9dv2t/Super_Enchants_Item_Compat.zip/file) to download a Super Enchants Item Compatibility Data Pack. Extract the zip file contents into a folder. Once you've done that, go to the file path data/superenchants/tags/item and modify the item tag json files. **Read the README.txt** as it will tell you exactly what you need to do.

# Experiencing Issues?

If you have any issues, just message me on [PlanetMinecraft](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/hauntedcorpse/)

Try and answer these questions when you first message me:
1. Is it on a Minecraft server, and if so, what type?
2. Which Minecraft version is it?
3. Is it vanilla, or modded? If modded, which mod loader? (Forge, Fabric, etc.)
4. If it's modded, which mod loader are you using?

Also, if you can, test the issues on a single-player vanilla world beforehand. This way you'll know for sure it's a problem with the data pack itself.

# No More Mutually Exclusive Enchantments!

With this pack, you're able to combine enchantments you couldn't combine before.
Here's a list of some things you can do in this pack.
- **Combine Infinity and Mending on a Bow.**
- **Use Infinity on a Crossbow.**
- **Combine Infinity and Mending on a Crossbow.**
- **Use All Protection Enchantments TOGETHER on Armor Pieces.**

# Config

Type **/function superenchants:config** to access the config of Super Enchants. Here, you can change the max levels of all enchantments that aren't hard-capped at level 1 by clicking the wrench to the left of the enchantment you want to change. By default, the max enchantment levels are set to their hard-cap. All of the enchantment level hard-caps are shown under the config image below.


![Config Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/tL7ebxr2/images/abbe794513537c3c8660bc5639248bca6c5f03ae.png)
![Edit Max Levels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/tL7ebxr2/images/d5c4400c840ff0936ce22c3de06f6e82d6ec682d.png)

# Enchantment Level Hard-caps

challenge-advancements.title: Challenge Advancements
challenge-advancements.description: A collection of custom advancements achievable in the mid to late-game, complete with unique reward items.
challenge-advancements.body:
This Datapack adds thirteen advancements (two of which are hidden).

The advancements can be found in-game under the 'Challenge Advancements' tab with the green book: 

![A screenshot of the 'Challenge Advancements' tab in-game. Accessed by pressing L by default.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8773f20a6b19fe4fa3b023fce697b4eefdab9e50.png)

Each advancement comes with a reward banner as a sort of trophy, these banners are not craftable in vanilla survival due to having more than six layers. 

![A screenshot of all the Reward Banners in-game; the A Jack Of All Trees banner depicts a tree with a gnarled twisting truck, the Dedicated Gardener banner depicts vines with splashes of colour, the Bow Before Me banner depicts a sun emblem and a grey background with gold stitches, The Nether's Champion banner is a design invoking flames, The Ocean's Champion banner depicts a Turtle Shell underwater, the For The Record banner depicts a Music Disc designed not to look like any particular in-game disc, the Smited banner depicts Lightning, the Knight of the Realm banner depicts a shield with a golden metal centre, the All-terrain Expert banner attempts to incorporate it's four relevant environments, the Titan Slayer banner depicts a dark monster breaking through a stone wall, the Indiana Jones banner Depicts what is best described as a temple in a forest and finally, the Being Sneaky Are You banner depicts a white potion particle on a blue background.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54cb01560cf0ba89c128a6a23fec3e49b81f8361.png)

The reward for the 'An Acquired Taste' advancement is a Bundle containing Music Discs with songs which you can't normally play in a jukebox in Survival. (including Alpha, Chrysopoeia, Dragon Fish, Wet Hands, pokopoko & more).
Due to technical limitations I can't put each individual song on it's own disc.
This Datapack uses the jukebox_song experimental setting, any custom Music Discs lose their sound events (which is what makes them play different songs) when the Datapack is uninstalled. 

![This image is showing off the various custom music discs granted as a reward for completing the 'An Acquired Taste' Advancement.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1026b9c99000de9e1b8002bb2baa9fc3def92f5c.png)

## List of all advancements not hidden:
![A screenshot of all not hidden Advancements added by this Datapack. (Text version below.)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/908dc0213117201c238994b858b9e0f68aa6821a.png)
### Text Version with Extra Details:
> **"Challenge Advancements" - A collection of custom advancements by Haunted_Magma & TheButterflyKing**
> The root advancement. It's granted when the player picks up or drops any item.
 
> **"Indiana Jones" - Explore every naturally generated structure**
> Structures treated like Features, like Desert Wells & Monster Rooms, don't count towards this advancement.

> **"For The Record!" - Collect all Music Discs acquirable by getting a Skeleton to shoot a Creeper**

> **"An Acquired Taste" - Listen to every Music Disc**
> Thanks to ioblackshaw of the Minecraft Commands Discord server for help with this advancement's reward item as well as everything in the jukebox_song file.

> **"All-Terrain Expert" - Use Leather Boots to walk on Powder Snow, breathe longer while swiming underwater with a Turtle Shell, walk on Soul Sand unhindered with the Soul Speed enchantment, wear gold armour to convince Piglins you're worth keeping around & avoid burning your feet on a Magma Block with the Frost Walker enchantment.**
> This advancement references armour pieces & enchantments that are useful in specific situations, like how Leather Boots help with Powder Snow & Gold armour pacifies Piglins.

> **"A Jack Of All Trees" - Collect one of every Sapling, gigantifiable Mushroom & Fungi**
> This advancement's title references the saying 'A jack of all trades but master of none.'

> **"Dedicated Gardener" - Collect every type of flower**
> This advancement completes with either a Dandelion or Golden Dandelion & an open or closed Eyeblossom.

> **"Titan Slayer" - Slay all Bosses & Mini-Bosses**
> The five Mobs that need to be killed for this advancement are: The Ender Dragon, The Wither, a Warden, an Elder Guardian & a Ravager.

> **"Knight of the Realm" - Ride a Horse whilst wearing a full set of Iron armour & wielding an Iron Sword or Spear & a Shield in the off-hand, & don't forget your steed's Iron Horse Armour**
> This advancement completes with any mount wearing Iron Horse Armour, not just horses.

> **"The Nether's Champion" - Ride a Happy Ghast & equip yourself with a full set of golden armour enchanted with Fire Protection IV, Soul Speed III Boots, a Fire Aspect II Golden Sword & a Flame Bow. (You may need to tip your hat to trigger advancement completion)**

> **"The Ocean's Champion" - Wear a Turtle Shell & Depth Strider III Boots, whilst wielding a Riptide III enchanted Trident, & under the effect of Breath of the Nautilus, Dolphins Grace & Conduit Power** Thanks to dragonmaster95 of the Minecraft Commands Discord server for helping make this advancement work as intended.

> **"Bow Before Me" - Acquire a full set of fully enchanted Netherite armour & Elytra, a Totem of Undying & fully enchanted Channelling Trident & Density Mace**
> This advancement completes with any combination of the mutually exclusive armour enchantments.


<details>
<summary>Hidden Advancements (Spoilers)</summary>

![Hidden Advancement, "Smited" With a banner depicting Lightning as it's Icon.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6cfe1d1eb53c153060f3e93f0535fa0dd2f25975.png)
> **"Smited" - You were just struck by lightning...**

plants-can-grow-in-trees.title: Plants Can Grow in Trees!
plants-can-grow-in-trees.description: This simple Datapack makes ferns, flowers etc. placeable on logs. Allowing for a little more creativity when building!
plants-can-grow-in-trees.body:
This simple Datapack allows for more creativity when building wooded or overgrown environments, **by making it possible to place ferns, grass & saplings etc. on logs.** i had the idea for this Datapack after hearing about temperate rainforests and of course i wanted to recreate one in Minecraft!
![A variety of plants; ferns, saplings, bamboo, flowers, etc. placed on logs and stems.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4fe829f6f9f661ffbbe46bc8851edc1ea26084c.png)

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/B0JXFskaA8o" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This Datapack works by adding #minecraft:logs to a bunch of block tags that define which blocks various plants can be placed on.

If the Datapack is uninstalled, any plants placed on logs will remain until given a block update.

### Mod Compatibility:
If a mod adds its logs to the #minecraft:logs block tag, **yes** plants will be placeable on those logs. You can check if a modded log is in the block tag in-game by looking at it with the F3 debug screen open.

crypticcosmos.body:
![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/cryptic-cosmos/cryptic-cosmos?style=flat-square)
[![Java CI with Gradle](https://github.com/Cryptic-Cosmos/Cryptic-Cosmos/actions/workflows/gradle.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Cryptic-Cosmos/Cryptic-Cosmos/actions/workflows/gradle.yml)

[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/modrinth-crypticcosmos-green.svg?style=flat-square)](https://modrinth.com/mod/crypticcosmos)

# Cryptic Cosmos
Cryptic Cosmos is a Minecraft mod (1.16.5, 1.17 support planned) focused on exploring dimensions and discovering new biomes, blocks and creatures.

There are 3 planned dimensions, but currently are only working on one - The Makrossa dimension. The Makrossa dimension is still very WIP, but it already has a lot of building blocks and decoration. There are 2 new mobs so far, with more to come!

To travel to the dimensions, use `/rift @p`, or find a rift (which will spawn around you as you explore). Enjoy!

## Important links
Checkout the mod at [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cryptic-cosmos) and on [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/crypticcosmos)!

Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/6BbUpV8jSk)!

![Discord Banner](https://discordapp.com/api/guilds/763236677601853462/widget.png?style=banner2)

## Credits

- [*Haunted Chest*](https://github.com/hauntedchest13): Creator, designer and owner
- [*TheOnlyTails*](https://theonlytails.com/): Lead Developer and co-owner
- [*LudoCrypt*](https://youtube.com/c/LudoCrypt): [OST](https://ludocrypt.bandcamp.com/album/mundus-volume-alpha) composer
- [*Realz*](https://youtube.com/kingrealzyt): Developer
- [*Chadboi27*](https://discordapp.com/users/507514606529544194): Artist & Modeler
- [*Frogge*](https://discordapp.com/users/780808380310487101): Artist
- [*Goomy*](https://discordapp.com/users/503610778490765332): Artist, Concept Artist and designer

## Disclaimer

This mod supports Minecraft version **1.16.5**. All versions lower are not guaranteed to work, and we do not bear the responsibility to support them.

Minecraft 1.17 is not yet supported by the Forge Team; However, we will update Cryptic Cosmos to 1.17 once the Forge Team releases a compatible version of their API. Once the mod is updated to 1.17, all 1.16.x versions will be unsupported.

This mod was built for use with the [Forge](https://forums.minecraftforge.net) mod loader, and no other. We do not bear the responsibility to support other ones, such as [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/) or Rift.

Some FAQs: https://github.com/Cryptic-Cosmos/Cryptic-Cosmos/wiki/FAQ

seasonal-decorations.body:
# 🎄 Seasonal Decorations
Bring cozy holiday vibes to your Minecraft world! 🕯️🎄 Decorate your home, village, or entire world for winter with glowing lights, festive candles, and magical snow-covered details.

![Update 2 Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/lcQpdCeI/images/ff6bc1e060d0dacffb2efef8896d97cbebfc9482.png)

## ❄️ About
**Seasonal Decorations** returns with a new chapter — **Winter & Christmas Edition!**
Add warmth and wonder to your builds with beautiful seasonal blocks designed for snowy towns, cozy cabins, and festive markets. Everything in the mod is fully decorative, lightweight, and server-friendly — perfect for builders and holiday lovers alike.

## 🎁 Features in v2.0: Winter Edition
- 🕯️ Frost & Amethyst Candles — shimmer with icy and magical glow.
- 🎄 Decorated Trees — glowing ornaments and twinkling garlands.
- 🧦 Christmas Stockings — hang them near the fireplace and wait for gifts!
- 🧊 Ice Lanterns — gentle blue light to illuminate your snowy nights.
- ☃️ Snowman & Gift Boxes — build cheerful scenes around your base.

(All blocks are purely decorative and optimized for building.)

## ✨ Upcoming updates
- 🪄 Magical snow globes and enchanted bells 🔔
- 🏠 Cozy furniture and winter hearths 🔥
- 🎇 Fireworks and festive garlands 💫
- 🎅 Santa’s mailbox and toy decorations 🎁

New updates will be released weekly throughout December to fill your world with holiday spirit!

## 🧡 Why you’ll love it
- ✅ Lightweight and lag-free
- ✅ Great for builders and mapmakers
- ✅ Multiplayer-friendly
- ✅ Works perfectly with other decoration mods

## 🛠️ Technical info
- Supported versions: 1.20.1 Forge, 1.21.1 NeoForge (more soon)
- No dependencies required
- Language support: English (more soon)

THANKS TO OUR SPONSORS

https://zap-hosting.com/reggarf

 

 

Description

This Mod is a Reforge of old mod - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/stoneholm For 1.20.1 to 1.21.1

Adding in sprawling mazes of underground halls and floors Stoneholm fills the world with a new type of village.

Explore confusing hallways & convert the place to your own home or build yours above it trapping the villagers underground for eternity, or just kidnap the villagers for your own not nefarious purposes.

Discover a Hidden World Beneath Your Feet!
Underground Villages – Stoneholm adds procedurally generated subterranean villages to your Minecraft world, built into sprawling underground chambers beneath the surface. These underground settlements offer a fresh and immersive survival experience, perfect for players who crave exploration and architectural wonder.

Villagers in these underground towns have carved out intricate halls, homes, farms, and meeting rooms, complete with lighting and decor that bring life to the depths. It's a great way to find shelter, trade, or even start your base in a whole new way.

🔧 Fully Configurable

Customize the experience to suit your world! The mod comes with full configuration support, allowing you to:

  • Adjust village size to make small cozy settlements or massive underground cities.

  • Set the maximum generation distance from the center to control where and how far underground villages spawn.

Whether you're building an adventure map, tweaking your survival world, or just want a more immersive villager experience, Stoneholm gives you full control.

burrowers.title: Burrowers
burrowers.description: Try to find these misterious lurking creatures and their villages underground!
burrowers.body:
### Participant MCreator x CurseForge ModJam 2024

![Main logo for the mod](https://i.ibb.co/ySkZmwR/logologo.png)

### Villagers, Illagers, and now introducing: ¡Burrowers!

‎
‎
![A burrower inspecting an item](https://i.ibb.co/XW0TkN8/imagen.png)

_A hidden society of **distant relatives of the villager** has adapted to the lack of light **underground** by turning into molemen, hoarding any resources they find while tunneling and building their homes. They seem friendly enough, but... **What could they be hiding?**_
‎

‎‎
### Blocks & Items


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![Touh root item icon](https://i.ibb.co/tHXz2HH/tough-root.png) **Tough Roots & Rootwood**

 The underground's main source of food. Break the roots that hang from the village ceiling to get a handful of them. While not having much nutritional value, you can find them really useful to build all the blocks and items you would expect from a new wood type, the rootwood


 
![Cave fern item icon](https://i.ibb.co/68PktcJ/cave-fern.png) **Cave Fern**

 A new vegetation block that can be potted and serves as decoration.

 
![Lichen Lantern item icon](https://i.ibb.co/8sdPtXH/lichen-lantern.png) **Lichen Lantern**

 Burrowers don't really care for lights as glowing lichen grow rampant in their homes. But when they feel fancy, they hang a **lichen lantern**, made from **glass**, **iron**, and said **lichen**. These emit a dimmer light than the regular lanterns, but the glass exterior looks really good!

 
![Cave stew item icon](https://i.ibb.co/bPmqyW2/cave-stew.png) **Cave Stew**

 A nutritious meal made with a tough root, silver dweller meat, and any mushroom.


 
![Haste potion item icon](https://i.ibb.co/BZ0F9BQ/haste-potion.png) **Haste Potion**

 Haste potions can now be crafted by using either a **dweller dung** or its **meat** in an awkward potion over the brewing stand. There are also **splash**, **lingering**, and **arrow** variants.


 
![New pottery patterns gif](https://i.ibb.co/2sCRs3M/pots.gif) **Pottery Patterns**

 Try to find new **Wail** and **Memory** pottery sherds! They seem designed by the burrowers, so what could these patterns mean for them? It also introduces a **blank** pottery sherd, which you can get by using the stonecutter with any other sherd.


 
![New music disc icon](https://i.ibb.co/5j1fvBS/music-disc-placebo.png) **Music Disc**

 A new track called "**Placebo**", by my friend [**elgavira**](https://open.spotify.com/intl-es/artist/1UvQwGhNMpOK3fqW1kBW8s)


</details>

‎‎
### Entities


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The mod includes three different entities, all featuring **custom sounds** and **animations**! A lot of care went into these to make them feel as alive as possible given the limited time frame and my coding knowledge. The new creatures are the following:

**Silver Dwellers**

![A silver dweller in its idle animation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a81fa3b8d2951ecd22f4557ab00299e136227f0.gif)

A **bigger** and **domesticated silverfish**. They are bred to help the burrowers build their villages and serve as a **food source**. They feed on different types of stone, and if they notice a stone block on the ground, **they'll rush to eat it and will spit it out turned into its smooth variant**. While doing this, they have a chance to drop a **dung item**. These creatures are **neutral** but will attack back any attacker, alerting other dwellers. They can be **bred** with **live silverfish**.

 
![Silver dweller meat item icon](https://i.ibb.co/HN8SRqy/raw-silver-dweller.png) **Silver Dweller Meat**

 Dropped by silver dwellers. A viable **food source**.

 
![Dweller dung item icon](https://i.ibb.co/W6Ttc9b/dweller-dung.png) **Dweller Dung**

 Functions like **bone meal** but for **ore veins**. Use it on an ore block to generate another one beside it. It generates **murky ore blocks**, which cannot be duplicated. It also has a chance to convert the original block into a murky one, but this won't affect its drop rates.

 
![A gif showcasing the murky ores](https://i.ibb.co/ck7Fx0j/murky-ores.gif) **Murky Ore Variants**

 They have the same functionality as **regular** ores and **deepslate** ores. They only generate when you use the dweller dung.

**Burrowers**

![A burrower in its idle animation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfb90ace0426c34f9d71135582a0e823e34c2280.gif)
 
 The protagonists of this mod, featuring **seven different variants**! These creatures lurk underground in their own cities, mainly around their giant root trees. They may flee from you at first, but will stop running if you bring any **fruit** item in your hand. If you drop them any kind of fruit, they'll stop to inspect it and **barter** with you, playing a cute custom animation. The barter loot table is the following, ordered by rarity:

-     Memory Pottery Sherd, Dweller Dung, Invisibility Potion, Invisibility Splash Potion, Emeralds, Shears, Murky Deepslate Redstone Ores, Silver Dweller Meat, Raw Iron, Rootwood Planks, Glow Lichen, Cave Fern, Raw Copper, Tough Root, Infested Deepslate Blocks, Clay Balls, Mud Blocks, Cobbled Deepslate

**Chief Burrower**

![A chief burrower in its idle animation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/820e4ff984334575fe3e2e7fa73e8ae9d272d47b.gif)

Meet the chief! In Burrower society, the wealthiest individual becomes the chief in charge of the town. You can find one per village, and they'll spend their time in the town market, where they store their goods. Unlike the regular burrowers, **these won't chase any fruit themselves**, but you can trade with them in a **custom menu**, featuring exclusive items and very useful trades. Here are the possible trades:

-     Ender Eyes, Sculk Veins, Echo Shards, Lava Buckets, Silver Dweller Meat, Budding Amethysts, Glow Lichens, Placebo Music Disc, Cave Stews, Murky Deepslate Redstone Ores, Tough Roots, Deepslate Blocks, Wail Pottery Sherd, Infested Cracked Stone Bricks, Raw Gold, Sculk 


</details>

### Burrower Village

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>


![The center of the village](https://i.ibb.co/VLbxRyz/imagen.png)

The main event of the mod, **a custom jigsaw structure with more than 25 possible pieces**! They generate in **taiga biomes** deep under the surface. Full of loot to find and mysteries to uncover, the burrower village makes use of all of the tools MCreator provides to bring to the game a fun structure to explore. I won't spoil the content, so try to find all of the different rooms!

</details>

### Resources and final notes

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Although it seems like a small mod, we made sure to put a lot of care and thought into all of the content. We spent the last month thinking every day about these creatures and how could they work in the Minecraft universe. Fun enough, I made the burrower model for the last MCreator modjam, in which I sadly couldn't participate. So, even if we don't end up winning I wouldn't change this experience for anything. It has been a rough few years, but I haven't stopped working on the stuff i really like, even if it's adding bits and crumbs of content to my mods every once in a while. But working as a team and with a purpose has been very, very fun. I've improved, and I plan on keep improving as I love this game and making content for it. 

- [**Curseforge**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/burrowers) (Curseforge page of the mod)
- [**MCreator**](https://mcreator.net/modification/107102/burrowers-mod) (MCreator page of the mod)
- [**Kaupenjoe**](https://www.youtube.com/@ModdingByKaupenjoe) (Great general tutorials for minecraft modding introduction)
- [**NorthWestTrees**](https://www.youtube.com/@NorthWestTreesMCreator) (Great jigsaw structure generation video guide)
- [**GentlemanRevvnar**](https://gist.github.com/GentlemanRevvnar) (A very detailed jigsaw structure generation written guide)
- [**MrCrayFish**](https://mrcrayfish.com/) (For references on how to code a custom merchant)

 

Thanks to my brother **Richy** for spending a whole month working with me (It's not that easy).
To **Fantasmiyo** and **Gavira** for producing the best **art** and **music** for the mod.
Thanks to my friends **Cruz**, **Key**, and **Neox** for helping out whenever I needed it.

And thanks to the **Minecraft Modding community** for **creating and keeping up my will to create**.
</details>

mystronics-undermod.title: Undermod
mystronics-undermod.description: Sewers that link villages together, giant craters, underground forests, rivers and seas.
mystronics-undermod.body:
![Undermod](https://i.imgur.com/9wJkdlz.png) **Discover the mysteries of interconnected underground biomes. From underground forests to vast ancient sewers that extend between villages, surprise might be waiting right beneath your feet ⏚**
--- ![Underbiomes](https://i.imgur.com/7xJeyF6.png) Undermod connects its *underbiomes* with one another in a meaningful way, creating new integrated exploration adventures in the underground. Explore dangerous places and find novel blocks to bring home for your builds! #### Available for Minecraft 1.16 and 1.20.1. Forge for now. **MC 1.12 and server-only** versions are also on the horizon. Compatible with most world generation mods.

Created by Mystronics. *Most textures and models by GGVegan.

--- ### What does Undermod include? - Adds natural and artificial **underground biomes** that depend on surface biomes. - **Adapts to existings worlds** so you don't miss anything, preventing hard seems between old and new chunks. - Connects faraway underbiomes with each other. For example, sewers usually discharge their water into underground rivers or seas. - **Completely procedural**. No fixed designs! Undermod generation rewards exploration and keeps the door open for low-probability extreme cases (for example, megacaves). There is always the possibility of surprise. - Works along with other world generation mods and follows the spirit of vanilla Minecraft. - Powered by new Mystronics world generation engine, optimized for low lag. --- # Underbiomes If Undermod gets enough downloads, you will see more of these coming! ## Ancient Sewers ![Ancient Sewers 1](https://i.imgur.com/g2jVDdU.png) Sewers can be found under Minecraft villages, sometimes linking multiple villages together through a net of flooded underground tunnels that stretch beneath the land. Water falls through narrow channels into larger ones, eventually discharging into underground rivers, or occasionally subterranean seas. The air is thick and water tainted, be prepared for poison. Wandering these passages, one might encounter long forgotten chambers - some abandoned, other repurposed. Outcasts have made these places their home - expect old living quarters, bandit hideouts, and more. Some say that villagers built on top of sewers for their hidden wealth and secret paths, while others believe that their ancestors took part in their construction. Wildlife has also settled inside sewers. Mushrooms, spiders, rats and slimes are well adapted to this biome. And in the dark waters, something moves... ![Ancient Sewers 2](https://i.imgur.com/MFVsUYS.png) **Tips to find them** Look for subtle entrances in villages. However, you will need to visit several villages to find sewers. Occasionally, they might be visible when they cross chasms or rivers. An easier way to visit sewers is by buying exploration maps from cartographer villagers. If you are out of emeralds or far from villages, it's also possible to find sewer maps hidden by bandits in underground forests. ## Underground Forests ![Underground Forest 1](https://i.imgur.com/TKlgylA.png) Surface forests can extend downwards in Undermod. Trees and other plants prosper under sinkholes, that let sunlight through into underground caverns. Certain type of small tree can even thrive under very dim light conditions, populating deeper caves that are completely dark to the human eye. This biome is very rich in coal, and can feature small amounts of lapis lazuli or even diamonds and glowstone. Given their size, underground forests usually give way to natural caves and chasms, and in rare cases explorers may also find connections to mineshafts, underground rivers or even ancient sewers, making these forests not just places of life, but crossroads in the depths. ![Underground Forest 2](https://i.imgur.com/vGcPeJe.png) **Tips to find them** Underground forests are fairly common, so you should be able to find them by exploring surface forests. Search for pits or sinkholes that show you what lies below. However, not all surface forests have an underground counterpart. ## Craters ![Crater 1](https://i.imgur.com/hhhwI5V.png) Formed by the impact of fallen asteroids, craters were carved into to the Overworld by massive explosions. These depressions cut through the earth below sea level, exposing caves, chasms and new mineshafts to the sun. Remains of large meteorites can normally be found at their center, with diverse mineral composition. Over time, nature has reclaimed these craters. Depending on their location, they may be covered in grass and trees, filled with water, or left as barren wastelands. Explorers are always on the lookout for meteorites because they say they can make you a fortune. However, be it out of superstition or due to some deeper knowledge, villagers avoid settlements anywhere near these eerie places; unworldly scars of the earth... ![Crater 2](https://i.imgur.com/q9Zf7CA.png) **Tips to find them** Craters are obviously easy to spot at surface level, but they are few and far between. If you want to find one without extensive exploration, your best bet is to look for old maps lost within ancient sewers, that mark areas of known celestial impact sites. ## Underground Rivers ![Underground River 1](https://i.imgur.com/8gK5TME.png) Water makes its way below surface in Undermod, creating long rivers that can extend under the Overworld. Explorers find underground rivers specially useful, because they provide a mostly safe passage to move by boat between distant surface points across a region. They feature less minerals than normal caves, but can connect several cave systems together. Some rivers eventually flow into subterranean seas. ![Underground River 2](https://i.imgur.com/rRNErNs.png) **Tips to find them** It's very hard to find underground rivers by exploring the surface because they lie several blocks beneath. If you manage to reach a subterranean sea, investigate its contours in search for rivers - there is a good chance one or more rivers empty their water into it. A more reliable method is to follow the water: sewers usually drain into rivers - trace their flow downward from village to an outfall, where the sewer meets the river current. ## Subterranean Seas ![Subterranean Sea 1](https://i.imgur.com/Zjyqz5f.png) All underground water needs to go somewhere, and so, eventually underground river streams feed into subterranean seas. Some no larger than a lake, others so vast that they stretch beyond sight, creating underground horizons. Despite the absence of sunlight, life has found a way to survive here. Some fish and isolated leeches can be found deep in the water. Drowned zombies are a potential threat. Like in rivers, water has washed away most minerals over time, but subterranean seas are gateways to a myriad of caves, and potentially underground structures to explore for treasure. ![Subterranean Sea 2](https://i.imgur.com/fwSV8Yi.png) **Tips to find them** Subterranean seas are uncommon and lie deep below the surface. Occasionally, chasms or even the surface ocean floor can show cracks that reveal their presence, but such openings are rare. Instead, a much easier way to find them is through underground rivers that flow into them. Also, old maps to subterranean seas have been lost inside Ancient Sewers... ## Caverns ![Caverns 1](https://i.imgur.com/ZkpUdUV.png) Undermod generates a variety of uncommon caverns of various sizes, making the underground (and mountains!) more interesting to explorers. You can recognize them by their stalactites. Larger cave volumes usually expose more minerals. ![Caverns 2](https://i.imgur.com/AKjEYHT.png) **Tips to find them** Explorer maps to caverns are not a thing, but caverns are fairly frequent. Sometimes they break through to the surface, but more often they remain hidden beneath layers of stone. Usually you'll need some old fashioned underground exploration to stumble upon them. They are more common under plains. --- # Mobs ### Leech ###### ![Leech Mob](https://i.imgur.com/Q974N0J.png) From blackened waters where light doesn't dare to shine, the leech is born. Unclean, as conjured from the filth itself, it drifts through murky waters always looking for its next victim, and for each stolen drop of life the leech restores its own vital energy. It's possible to use a forge to harness the life draining power from their teeth, but only piercing weapons can take it. They avoid dry areas, as they are clumsy outside water, but never underestimate them when they swim, specially when they attack in numbers. The only thing they seem to fear is flaming fire; its heat driving them back into the depths. --- ### Rat ###### ![Rat Mob](https://i.imgur.com/5I1ZSwz.png) Fast and quiet, rats dash through damp sewer tunnels and small caves where predators can't reach them. They climb on walls and are able to slip through the bars of Understeel Fences. Either they are bloodless, or they have struck some unspoken pact with the leeches, for they can swim through the creatures’ water pools unnoticed. Rats are usually harmless, but they are quick to snatch anything left unattended. --- # Blocks Bring new blocks and ways of building from your adventures to your base! ### Heaps of Filth These piles of decay are magnets for certain types of creatures. When submerged under water, they slowly attract new leeches. On solid ground, they invite slimes. The spawning is slow, and can only happen when placed in murky biomes, like sewers or swamps. A single block is not sufficient - you need a decent amount to start the process. The larger the heap, the more likely it is to spawn these creatures. ###### ![Heap of Filth](https://i.imgur.com/Ku3tAgb.png) ##### **Uses and Dangers** If you want to clear all leeches and slimes from your sewers, the only way to stop them from returning is to clean out every **Heap of Filth**. But filth isn’t always a burden - the experienced explorer might find its own uses for it. You could potentially move them somewhere else to function as a farm, but beware: moving these heaps around always results in some of the material being lost along the way. Also, for those willing to keep digging through the grime, there’s always a chance of finding something shiny buried within, long forgotten inside the heap. ### Understeel Blocks ###### ![Understeel Fences](https://i.imgur.com/h1WXYto.png) _Understeel_ is a versatile metal used for creating thin, grated structures. For now, the only way to get these blocks is by mining them in Ancient Sewers. Fences alone can be used to craft the rest of them, but not the other way around. Understeel **fences** function similarly to glass panes but attach to the edges of blocks rather than the center, making them useful for building **cages, railings, and barriers** with a more open design. **Understeel trapdoors and doors** complete the set, giving more options for construction. Trapdoors cannot be opened manually but respond to redstone signals, making them ideal for grated floors, but also mechanical activation builds. Doors, on the contrary, work like traditional doors, serving as manual metal doors. ###### ![Sewer storage room](https://i.imgur.com/16DWCOk.png) *Damp bricks, understeel fences and small barrels; used to create a storage room on the walls of a sewers tunnel.* --- ### More There are more secret items waiting to be discovered in Undermod. ###### Quick tips: - *Black Veil Mushrooms* can only grow under very dark conditions, but if you can make your farm work, they are a wonderful alternative to Nether Wart for brewing. - *Lost Key* and *Occult Hand Mirror* are still placeholders, so you won't be able to do anything with them yet. You can sell mirrors to high-level Clerics for 32 emeralds, but if you manage to find one of these items you might want to keep it - future versions of Undermod will reveal their purpose. They are very rare! ###### ![Undermod Item List](https://i.imgur.com/Vj9MbwH.png) _Come exploring!_ ###### ![Undermod Item List](https://i.imgur.com/HsE0au3.png)

warhammer-universe-mod.title: Warhammer Fantasy Mod
warhammer-universe-mod.description: Fantasy Warhammer Mod, added weapons, dwarf villages in mountains also underground, Skaven and Pegasus
warhammer-universe-mod.body:
Description

This Mod has the aim of bringing the Warhammer Universe to minecraft. The mods brings weapons from the universe, creatures and structures.

Go on an adventure on top of a Pegasus, fighting new enemies with new weapons.
![Flying on top of a Pegasus](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xahvYN5k/images/16a9e9bc64b5fb506575573989e03b7a71b1603b_350.webp)
![Skaven Patrol](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/xahvYN5k/images/a874c35611301bdbb3bd504ce05c4183aaf181f2_350.webp)

Discover new Dwarf Villages in the mountains, both above and underground.
![Dwarf Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c060991626f01c6ac799a29eab3713a7a2353142_0.webp)
![Underground Village](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e54e7d217ba0b8829c9043d6a7086ee5e2e14e56_0.webp)

(see Warhammer wiki on fandom for some lore https://warhammerfantasy.fandom.com/wiki/Warhammer_Wiki )

![Melee Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d5addf90ca60198d6f7ac7a8dc844062fb68a48.png)

The basic weapons you can craft:

  - Warhammer (heavy hitter, but slow attack speed)

  - Spear (less damage than a sword but faster attack speed + can be thrown)

  - Knife (few damage but fast attack speed (could be useful against baby zombies))

  - Halberd(slower than a sword but hits harder, has a right click  attack with an extended reach) 

 ![Ranged Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37b9532dbec0f4d907521a560de3152389cd89e9.png)

The Ranged Weapons you can craft:

-sling: just a sling allow you to throw cobblestone

-Flintlock Pistol(reloads faster but deal less damage)

-Musket (stronger than a bow but slower to fire)

-Blunderbuss(deadly at close range but loses damage rapidly at a distance).

-Grenade Launcher(takes grenades as ammo, punch  increases explosion size, power increases the velocity of the projectile)

-Gunsword (sword and a pistol at the same time)

-Nuln Repeater Rifle (same as a musket but times 6 (thus also takes a longer time to reload)

Special Weapons:
![Special weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfdf5eca0f53bad3f5c32eb6885bc0fc5f63f793.png)

In the mountains you might encounter Dwarves, but be careful those little guys don't like it when they are attacked, and they know how to fight. Moreover, they have their own unique trades with new items:

-Beer: a good drink that gives you bonuses, but drink with moderation

-Thunderer Handgun: a powerful and robust musket

-Grudgeraker: a 2 shot and robust blunderbuss

-Drakegun: a powerful flamethrower 

-WarPick: a strong pick that can even be used effectively in melee

-Ghal Maraz: difficult to get but a Legendary very strong weapon.

the Farmer: like a normal farmer but sells beer.

the Miner: sells you minerals(including quartz),sells minecarts,golden rails,TNT,...) but also a war pick.

the Builder: sells you non renewable blocks(clay,red sandstone,quartz) 

the Lord : a rare villager whi will donate, after a succesful raid, the legendary Ghal Maraz the most powerful warhammer know who buff you in combat. It is spawned from other dwarves that are master traders.

the Engineer: sells you everything you need for your gunpowder weapons, including 2 special ranged weapons and just in case you need it diamond chainmail armor. 

the Slayer: buys cooked meat and sells mob heads.

![Family Picture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a853f0f14f928442a804d65f3a7f3de60b8f1483.png)


 Tradable armor:
 ![Diamond Chainmail Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd7f47936d92bafe543606649fe2449008664e6e.png)

Deep under the ground are lurking the rat-like creatures of the Skaven. These twisted creatures bring dangerous warpstone powered weapons, you might be able to steal there equipment from them if you manage to kill them.

 

In the mountains you might also be able to find a pegasus and tame it: this mighty steed will allow you to fly through the air. in stationary mode: flies slowly but  it can stay "stationary" in the air and climb fast and a "elytra" mode: where it fly fast in the air and can remain at a high speed. (double press spacebar to change mode.

 

You can also craft yourself some new shields with their own unique properties: the long elven shields allow you to block shots while aiming with a gun, while the other small shields allow you to run while using the shield.


For info:

from the version 1.21 you can obtain a description book by pressing the button

philips-ruins.title: Philips Ruins
philips-ruins.description: This mod adds ancient ruins to your Minecraft world
philips-ruins.body:
![Title](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/569737/description_c050e312-212d-4723-aa7b-e6c72c16585b.png)
Philip’s Ruins is a Minecraft ruins generator mod for Forge and Fabric, and it supports the latest Minecraft versions to date. The mod adds over 190 different types of ruin variants to the game, each with their own unique custom loot tables. This includes some hidden bosses that you can discover while exploring the lost remnants of ruins. The mod aims to add ancient ruins similar to what you see in real life by introducing lore to Minecraft, thereby enhancing gameplay functionality.
Two interesting features of this mod are:
- Most loot will likely be buried underground or covered with stones from the ruins.
- Unlike other structure mods, Philip’s Ruins makes most of its structures look like actual ruins. 

This is achieved by blending the ruin with the terrain instead of having a rigid drop-off at the end of a structure, which is common in most mods during rough terrain generation.
This approach makes the ruins you come across look like they were there before any other structures, like villages, came to pass. It gives a vintage, ancient look to the current ruins, maintaining the structure along with terrain erosion.

[![Philip's Ruins Data Pack](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/569737/description_5a9bfc02-4142-472d-ae48-c730fa75ef26.png "Philip's Ruins Data Packet")](https://modrinth.com/datapack/philips-ruins-datapack)

If you would like to support the mod’s development, join our Discord server. We post updates on what’s going on with the community, and you’re free to ask questions about the mod or any other topic. Also, if you would like to join our Patreon, click the Patreon button. We really appreciate the support, and every contribution goes to our team. Patrons will get a shout-out during the description of the mod and on our YouTube channel. So far, here are some people who have contributed to this project.

[![Cubus Studio](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/569737/description_8226cee9-f32c-414b-8185-4dedbcfae151.png "Cubus Studio")](https://discord.gg/rxnBrcWP5R)

explore-ruins-aether.title: Explore Ruins: The Aether - Dungeons & Structures
explore-ruins-aether.description: New dungeons and structures in the Aether dimension.
explore-ruins-aether.body:
![mod logo with three pictures of dungeons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/78b593d0c89e99354f12254cc65421edd6258a8a.png)
**Available on [Curseforge](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/explore-ruins-aether) & [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/explore-ruins-aether)**

**Requires: [The Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether)**

## 📖**About:**
**Explore Ruins: The Aether** is a lightweight structure generation mod that improves your adventures and world exploration in The Aether dimension. Most structures have rare variants or minor random differences, so there's a chance to encounter something new even on your 50th playthrough.



## 🏰**Structures:**
![moa bird in nest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be10954c927711cb0d5aa11b26e7a82082062680.png)
### **Moa Nest**
_'A small island is a preferred nesting ground for Moa birds'_

![floating island with a sky lake and dock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f8ec87595b2e4f5dfd45d768a8e91c19143f8801.png)
### **Sky Lake**
_'A floating island with a lake is a perfect place for fishing in the paradise!'_

![a holy stone circle with a tree on a floating island](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fd6397ae421a861e86107232ed5085f03f2fe61.png)
### **Holystone Circle**
_'An ancient circular structure made of sacred stone may hide something valuable... or not'_

![a sky shrine with pillars made of angelic stone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/08d29b453a1b5a01f108a4a025f6a26225d0d3b2.png)
### **Holy Shrine**
_'A sacred altar containing a chest with precious offerings'_

![a flying valkyrie ship with cloud sails](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8edaea16ed7fe108c9786e96d3cba963596baf0f.png)
### **Valkyrie Ship**
_'A flying ship with aercloud sails used by valkyries for their travels and numerous battles'_

![an interior of library with bookcase, potted plants and chandelier](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ceaa397f09c87679a06d531ab8884e8bf13dcddc.png)
### **Valkyrie Library**
_'A smaller antique building where valkyries and mimics guard ancient knowledge'_

![a red room with glowstone lanterns and fiery monsters](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a30a38faec0e00df9e4d8734374ecd637803fedb.png)
### **Small Hellfire Dungeon**
_'This golden oak island conceals scorching rooms that are dangerous even without the help of mighty Sun Spirit'_

## 📦 Compatibility & Recommended Mods
This mod should be compatible with everything by default. It's made for use in any modpacks.
However, there are mods that go especially very well with this one.

- [Dragon Survival](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/dragons-survival) - flying like a dragon through the aether is more fun than building bridges!
- [Realm RPG: Fallen Adventurers](https://modrinth.com/mod/realm-rpg-fallen-adventurers) - even more exploration, skeletons generate well alongside new structures.
- [Aether: Basic Ores](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether-basic-ores) - even fewer empty areas of the landscape are empty, look for valuable ores!
- [Farmers Structures](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-structures) - even more new houses & structures in the aether dimension.
- [Farmer's Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-delight) - structures can contain items and blocks useful for cooking, so there is less need to leave aether.
- [Aether Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/aether-delight) - makes many items from structure chests even more useful for crafting and cooking.


## 💬 Permissions

✔️ You are allowed to include this mod in [Curseforge](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/explore-ruins-aether) & [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/explore-ruins-aether) modpacks and use this mod in your videos. A link to the mod page in the description is highly appreciated.

❌ You are not allowed to reupload this mod to any other websites/launchers/apps, use any contents of this mod (structures, tags, etc) in other projects, put this mod behind any adfly-like links, sell this mod in any way or include in paid modpacks - this mod is free for all players.

forgotten-ruins.title: Forgotten Ruins
forgotten-ruins.description: Explore mysterious ruins hidden in jungles, swamps, and mangroves. Face ancient golems, loot cursed relics, and uncover the forgotten legacy of a lost civilization
forgotten-ruins.body: # 🗿 Forgotten Ruins **Forgotten Ruins** is a Minecraft mod that brings mysterious temples and lost relics into the heart of the jungle, swamps, and mangrove biomes. Inspired by the **dark fantasy atmosphere of Shadow of the Colossus**, this mod invites players to explore long-forgotten sanctuaries, remnants of an ancient civilization protected by silent golems now reactivated by your presence. The mod REQUIRE Dawn of Time & Armor of the Ages (+the dependencies) ## Join our social networks [![social networks](https://i.imgur.com/Hpz5KXl.png)](https://linktr.ee/TheGoldenWorld) ![Separator](https://i.imgur.com/yhha6Zo.png) ## 🔍 What to expect * **Handcrafted ruins** with secrets, parkour, traps, and thematic loot * **Dark, decayed architecture** that blends naturally into the jungle, swamp, or mangrove * **Custom loot tables**: damaged relics, cursed treasures, forgotten weapons and potions * **Guardian golems**: silent sentinels, some still watchful… others unstable * A mix of **exploration, tension, and high rewards** for those who reach the heart of the ruins * No two ruins are identical—**each has its own layout, lore, and dangers** ![Separator](https://i.imgur.com/yhha6Zo.png) ## Gameplay design Forgotten Ruins is not just decorative. Each structure is built like a **mini dungeon**: you’ll have to **explore**, **climb**, **avoid traps**, and face **ancient defense systems**. It rewards players who take the risk—loot is rare, powerful, and often tied to the **Armor of the Ages** mod (with worn-out legendary armor, gold, potions, and enchanted relics). ![Separator](https://i.imgur.com/yhha6Zo.png) ## Mod ecosystem Forgotten Ruins is part of the **Dawn of Time** mod family. It uses building blocks, mobs, and loot assets from the following : * [Dawn of Time](https://modrinth.com/mod/dawn-of-time) – core assets & historical blocks * [Armor of the Ages](https://modrinth.com/mod/armor-of-the-ages) – animated armor models & gear * [Ancient Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/ancient-structure) – cultural overworld generation These mods work independently but complement each other to create a rich worldbuilding and exploration experience. ![Separator](https://i.imgur.com/yhha6Zo.png) ## Feedback & Support We'd love to hear your thoughts, suggestions, or bug reports ! Feel free to join our community or support the project here: [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/dawnoftime) [Support us on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/dawnoftime) 🧡 Every message, idea, or share helps us keep building the Dawn of Time universe! ![Separator](https://i.imgur.com/yhha6Zo.png) ## Credits * **TheGoldenWorld** – creator of the original datapack and all core structures * [Superchache39](https://www.youtube.com/@superchache39) - I learned with his videos to make datapacks * [ChatGPT](https://openai.com/) has been used to wrap up this page in markdown & it helped me to create features in the mod * [Retro Diffusion](https://www.retrodiffusion.ai/) has been used to generate the logo and the banner of this page * [Minecraft Title Generator](https://ewanhowell.com/plugins/minecraft-title-generator/) from Ewan Howell has been used for the banner. [Support](https://ko-fi.com/ewanhowell) this guy, he is a goddamn hero

petra.title: Petra - Ruins Structure ✅
petra.description: Petra is an ancient desert city in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by the rock-carved wonders of Jordan, featuring monumental facades and hidden passages.
petra.body:
![Petra front](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8rE3l6uj/images/f6c4893a665cb8226a3e01b71f26e6725208e778.png)

Step into the past and uncover the lost city of Petra with the **Petra Mod**! This mod introduces stunning **rock-carved facades and ancient desert ruins** into Minecraft, appearing in mesa and desert biomes as monumental structures hidden within cliffs. Each site captures the grandeur and mystery of the real-world wonder, filling your world with **history, exploration, and secret treasures**.

![Petra fish eye](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8rE3l6uj/images/3f1720c66793b0861fec14038455e0e8262fc113.png)

Perfect for players who enjoy **exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration**, the Petra ruins serve as unique points of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures. Wander through the carved facades, admire the monumental desert architecture, and let your imagination journey into the mysteries of an ancient civilization hidden in stone.

![Petra river](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/8rE3l6uj/images/39518a8a08de182bdf2a1ee9c0a220cad26d80a6.png)

Whether you're a **solo explorer or part of a multiplayer server**, these ruins bring **atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling** potential to your world. Petra is more than a monument—it’s an invitation to uncover the wonders of ancient civilizations while enhancing the desert beauty of your Minecraft landscapes.

stonehenge.title: Stonehenge - Ruins Structure ✅
stonehenge.description: Stonehenge is a prehistoric monument in Minecraft vanilla-friendly taking inspiration from prehistoric massive stones in England, featuring mysterious ruins and hidden loot.
stonehenge.body:
![Stonehenge](https://i.imgur.com/2I9I3VS.jpeg)

Step into the past and explore the enigmatic world of ancient megaliths with the **Stonehenge Mod**! This mod introduces **realistically generated Stonehenge ruins** into Minecraft, appearing in plains biomes as impressive circles of towering standing stones. Each ruin captures the mysterious aura of the real-world monument, making your world feel alive with **history, archaeology, and ancient secrets**.

![Stonehenge POV](https://i.imgur.com/KoAoVGI.jpeg)

Perfect for players who enjoy **exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration**, the Stonehenge ruins serve as unique points of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures. Wander among the stones, admire the monumental architecture, and let your imagination wander through the echoes of a forgotten past.

![Stonehenge Mountains](https://i.imgur.com/ydVG6Ku.jpeg)

Whether you're a **solo explorer or part of a multiplayer server**, these ruins bring **atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling potential** to your world. Stonehenge is more than a structure—it’s an invitation to uncover the mysteries of ancient civilizations while enhancing the natural beauty of your Minecraft landscapes.

moss-ruins.title: Moss Ruins
moss-ruins.description: A vanilla-like datapack adding new content to embrace some parts of the boring birch forest biomes by adding a new set of structures which spawn as small single buildings or big ruined cities
moss-ruins.body:
Moss Ruins datapack is a vanilla-like addition of new structures being added to the normally boring birch forests, they vary from being a single building, or they spawn as a large cities scattered around these forests.
It adds up a little bit of spice to birch forests, and if you want to, you can use the Terralith datapack with it by using another version of it.

I hope you'll get happy by encountering these ambient or content structures!

ruins-and-towers.title: Ruins and Towers
ruins-and-towers.description: Bring back ruins from a forgotten past. Explore a world full of structures. And defeat bosses never before seen!
ruins-and-towers.body:
This pack/mod aims to fill the lack of structures in Minecraft.

## Challenge Towers
Every Challenge Tower consists of 4 to 7 floors and a bossfight.
As you ascend, you'll fight against mobs and earn some loot!
You can make it harder by drinking an Ominous Bottle.

Every boss has 100-120 HP and a custom bossbar.
Once you defeat them, they'll drop their weapon.
You will also get a Rune, which will be used to unlock a future structure.

### Dry Challenge Tower
It generates in badlands, savannas, and deserts.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturally generated Dry Challenge Tower](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12c60f43d253e570c394d9857254584d40b2f6cc_0.webp)

<details>
<summary>Bossfight</summary>

![Krah-Yan's Shadow's Bossfight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84135c315feefa623c439acd7a2da8bcd299a940_0.webp)

</details>

</details>



### Chilling Challenge Tower
It generates in ice spikes, snowy plains, and snowy taigas.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturally generated Chilling Challenge Tower](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41f11a0720e60e33dda34fad01951d6c0432013a_0.webp)

<details>
<summary>Bossfight</summary>

![Borealis Archmage Bossfight](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3efe55deead8f3bb8a724b3be0c069792057496f_0.webp)

</details>

</details>



## Badlands Temple
It generates in all badlands biomes.

This structure will feature up to 4 decorations on its corners and 2 traps underneath.

As unique loot, you can find the unused fire and earth paintings.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturaly generated Badlands Temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b54975c5dd817cc219e91c6135954d102c62c88a_0.webp)

<details>
<summary>Loot</summary>
  
![Badlands Temple loot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4d76c205bde57f671f3db4a6ab6567e74b07854.png)

</details>

</details>



## Pale Outpost
It generates in the pale garden.

This structure will feature 4 decorations on the top floor and a random number of barrels on the second floor.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturaly generated Pale Outpost](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a672eed6e5d54d726fae671fe118f7c41088fdf_0.webp)

<details>
<summary>Loot</summary>
  
![Pale Outpost loot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0199c09d6fa400f9d0a739e2333fd1e866a95254.png)

</details>

</details>



## Stonehenge
It generates in plains biomes.

It's not meant to be an exact replica of the real one. It features 2 rings of stones and a central decoration, sometimes containing iron or copper.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturaly generated Stonehenge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ca8dca7a23bfc37d72c986ffc72303f9a729a20_0.webp)

</details>



## Sculk Chimney
It generates above deep darks.

As you mine your way down, you'll find ores such as diamonds, redstone, or gold.. and tons of sculk.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturally generated Sculk Chimney](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48b56717b62165b14ef53ec4eac380b7e0010a80_0.webp)

</details>



## Creeper Shrine
It generates in sparsed jungles and bamboo jungles.

3 shelves above and 4 waiting in a secret basement.

You'll get some early-game suplies and pottery sherds.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturally generated Creeper Shrine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41a4399620fcc11ed4736820eb7a816b41378e76_0.webp)

</details>



## Calcite Obelisc
It generates in meadows.

This structure features 8 runes on the exterior and 5 rooms.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturaly generated Calcite Obelisc](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b564e114eacb9cc0efb72d0a1072d67e64d63919_0.webp)

<details>
<summary>Loot</summary>
  
![Calcite Obelisc loot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c61b5735c715f8a2a8d7f9487c553a21569385ea.png)

Only the storage room contains barrels
</details>

</details>



## Generic Stone Ruins
It generates in forests.

You'll find some pillars over suspicious gravel, gravel, and course dirt.

After brushing the suspicios gravel, you may get the Ancient Stone Knive or the Ancient Leather Shield. 

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturaly generated Generic Stone Ruins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9b47b6eb3b2f2c31eeaa8d70b848636952857f6.png)

</details>



## Prismarine Cage
It generates in all warm oceans, and regular oceans.

Each Prismarine Cage has a random reward. It could be a conduit, or just a sea lantern.

<details>
<summary>Structure</summary>

![Naturally generated Prismarine Cage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93d9cfd6db2ddc0aeb5776e6faaafd07f92067b9_0.webp)

</details>

delfos.title: Delfos - Ruins Structure ✅
delfos.description: Delfos is an ancient monument in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by the Oracle of Apollo, featuring massive ruins and mystical columns.
delfos.body:
![Delfos front](https://i.imgur.com/il0ZhFG.png)

Step into antiquity and discover the sacred sanctuary of Delfos with the **Delfos Mod**! This vanilla-friendly mod brings **grand, classical Greek ruins inspired by the Oracle of Apollo** into Minecraft, spawning on terraced mountainsides and rocky hills in mountain and forest biomes. Each site recreates the awe of the original sanctuary—crumbling colonnades, a luminous inner chamber, and vaults—filling your world with **lore, exploration, puzzles, and secret treasures**.

![Delfos aerial](https://i.imgur.com/RUql2sB.png)

Perfect for players who enjoy **exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration**, the Delfos ruins serve as unique points of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures. Wander through crumbling colonnades, admire terraced sanctuaries and weathered mosaic floors, and let your imagination journey into the mysteries of an ancient Greek oracle carved into the mountainside.

![Delfos site](https://i.imgur.com/gHJo4BL.png)

Whether you're a **solo explorer or playing on a multiplayer server**, these ruins add **atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling** potential to your world. Delfos is more than a monument—it's an invitation to uncover the mysteries of ancient Greece and the Oracle of Apollo, while enhancing the rugged, terraced beauty of mountainsides and forests in your Minecraft landscapes.

ancient-jungle-ring.title: Ancient Jungle Ring - Ruins Structure ✅
ancient-jungle-ring.description: Ancient Jungle Ring is a vanilla-friendly jungle city built as a stone ring with overgrown facades, hidden passages, flooded chambers, terraced walkways and rustic bridges.
ancient-jungle-ring.body:
![1](https://i.imgur.com/Kv6uHOP.png)

Step into the past and uncover the lost city of Ancient Jungle Ring with the Ancient Jungle Ring Mod. This mod introduces overgrown circular stone cities and ancient jungle ruins into Minecraft, spawning in jungle biomes as monumental ringed structures hidden beneath the canopy. Each site captures the grandeur and mystery of forgotten ringed architecture, filling your world with history, exploration, and secret treasures.

![2](https://i.imgur.com/iX6RnJe.png)

Perfect for players who enjoy exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration, Ancient Jungle Ring serves as a unique point of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures. Wander through overgrown ringed facades, admire monumental stone architecture reclaimed by the jungle, and explore the mysteries of an ancient civilization hidden beneath the canopy.

![3](https://i.imgur.com/OD6sAsG.png)

Whether solo or on a multiplayer server, these ringed ruins add atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling potential to your world. Ancient Jungle Ring is more than a ruin—an invitation to uncover lost civilizations beneath the canopy while enriching jungle biomes with overgrown stone architecture.

![4](https://i.imgur.com/k5BESjC.png)

_Ancient Jungle Ring Mod transforms your Minecraft jungles with immersive ancient ruins designed for exploration, lore, and survival gameplay. Featuring monumental ringed structures, hidden passages, flooded chambers, and vine-covered facades, it offers players endless opportunities to build, explore, and roleplay within lush biomes. Perfect for adventurers seeking new landmarks, unique world-generation, and culturally inspired architecture, this mod enhances jungle environments with mystery, atmosphere, and discovery._

Each site captures the grandeur and mystery of the original monument—massive beehive-shaped burial chambers, long stone entrance passages, and towering walls—filling your world with **history, exploration, puzzles, and secret treasures**.

![2](https://i.imgur.com/HEl0q3N.png)

Perfect for players who **enjoy exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration**, the Mycenae monument serves as a unique point of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures. Wander through ancient stone passageways, explore the grand beehive-shaped burial chamber, and let your imagination journey into the legends of heroes and kings from Greece’s ancient past.

![3](https://i.imgur.com/TGYZZCr.png)

Whether you're a **solo explorer or playing on a multiplayer server**, these ruins add **atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling** potential to your world. Mycenae is more than a monument—it’s an invitation to uncover the legends of ancient Greece and its heroic past, while enhancing the rugged hills and mountainous landscapes of your Minecraft world.
